Precautions
Being Taken
For Dailies

Further Threats Received
By Papers; Bullet
Proof Shelters

With threats of further attacks having been received by the two Chinese dailies which were the object of the terrorists' attack on Avenue Edward VII on Saturday night, special precautionary measures against any such recurrence were taken by the police authorities of both the International Settlement and the French Concession, as well as the managements of the papers.

Part of the roadway in the vicinity of the "Chinese-American Daily News" and the "China Daily News," situated in a lane beside "The Shanghai Times" Building, was cleared of all vehicles from early yesterday afternoon and an armoured car of the French Police was placed across the street from the entrance, commanding a perfect vantage point. At the same time patrols of uniformed and plainclothes men were operating over the area, being ready to meet any further terrorist attacks.

Mr. Harry M. Sturkgold, president of the Roosevelt Publishing Company, publishers of the "Chinese-American Daily News," stated yesterday that he was making plans to build a bullet and bomb proof wall around the plant of his paper and around its offices and at the same time to install an alarm with a direct connection to the Central Police Station. In order that the alarm should be used he contemplated putting seven separate buttons in different parts of the building.

Special protection was also being afforded by the French Police the "Ta Mei Wao Pao," the Chinese edition of the Shanghai "Evening Post and Mercury."

为日报采取的预防措施

各报收到进一步威胁；防弹掩体

鉴于上周六晚在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）遭到恐怖分子袭击的两家中文日报已收到进一步的袭击威胁，公共租界和法租界的警方当局以及报社管理层均采取了特别的预防措施，以防此类事件再次发生。

从昨天下午早些时候起，位于《上海泰晤士报》大楼旁弄堂内的《中美日报》和《中国日报》附近的道路部分已清空所有车辆，一辆法国警察的装甲车横停在入口对面的街道上，占据了极佳的制高点。与此同时，身着制服和便衣的巡逻人员在该区域活动，随时准备应对任何进一步的恐怖袭击。

《中美日报》出版商罗斯福出版公司（Roosevelt Publishing Company）总裁哈里·M·斯特克戈尔德（Harry M. Sturkgold）先生昨日表示，他正计划在其报社厂房及办公室周围修建防弹防爆墙，同时安装与中央捕房直接连接的警报器。为了使用警报器，他考虑在大楼的不同部位设置七个独立的按钮。

法国警察也为上海《晚邮报与水星报》（Evening Post and Mercury）的中文版《大美晚报》提供了特别保护。

Pro-Chungking Terrorists Are
Blamed for Saturday Battle

Substantiating Evidence Claimed in Hands of
Japanese; Police Said Studying Objective

CONTRADICTING newspaper reports to the effect that the
shooting affray on Avenue Edward VII, which cost the lives
of four persons and as a result of which some 20 persons were
injured, the spokesman at yesterday's Japanese press conference
said that, according to the information in the hands of the Japanese
authorities, the attack on the newspaper building was made by
pro-Chungking terrorists in an attempt to create friction between
the S.M.P.—a body with British preponderance—and the Japanese
authorities, so as to slow up the successful negotiations at present
going on in Tokyo.

Asked by one of the correspond-
ents, what the objective of pro-
Chungking terrorists would be in
attacking fervent supporters of the
Chungking Government, the spokes-
man said that the matter was at
present being investigated by the
Shanghai Municipal Police but that
it is suggested that the papers
attacked as a result of their having
toned down greatly in their anti-
Japanese attitude. A correspondent
then pointed out that one of the two
papers attacked by the terrorists had
received numerous threatening letters
from a pro-Wang Ching-wei organ-
ization in which destruction of the
premises was forecast if it did not
stop its anti-Wang Ching-wei attitude
and that the coup was staged but a
few days after the very same paper
had published the denunciation of
Mr. Wang Ching-wei by the Chung-
king authorities.

Considered Serious

Asked whether the Japanese
authorities considered the incident
serious, the spokesman replied that
it was serious in view of persistent
reports that the Chinese are planning
the assassination of Sir Archibald
Clark Kerr, H. M. Ambassador to
China, with a view to preventing the
successful conclusion of Anglo-Japan-
ese parleys in Tokyo.

"If any evidence is produced that
the terrorists had connections with
pro-Wang Ching-wei groups, would
the Japanese authorities co-operate
with the Shanghai Municipal Police
in rounding up the gang?" asked a
correspondent.

"They will have to prove that first.
As repeatedly stated, the Japanese
military authorities are deeply in-
terested in the maintenance of peace
and order in the foreign areas here
and should any elements be found
to run counter to this Japanese policy,
the Japanese would of course co-
operate in eradicating them, provided
that their guilt is proved."

"Have you something more con-
crete regarding the information that
the terrorists were directed by the
Chungking Government?" asked a
correspondent.

"Do you ask the police where they
get their information?" was the
answer.

亲重庆恐怖分子被指为周六枪战元凶

日方称掌握确凿证据；警方据称正在研究其动机

针对报纸报道中称周六晚在爱多亚路发生的枪击事件导致四人死亡、约二十人受伤的说法，日本新闻发布会发言人在昨日予以反驳。他表示，根据日本当局掌握的信息，对报社大楼的袭击是由亲重庆恐怖分子所为，企图在上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.，一个由英国人占主导地位的机构）与日本当局之间制造摩擦，从而延缓目前正在东京进行的成功谈判。

当一名记者问及，亲重庆恐怖分子袭击重庆政府热烈支持者的目的何在时，发言人称，上海公共租界工部局警务处目前正在调查此事，但有迹象表明，这些报纸之所以受到攻击，是因为它们极大地缓和了反日态度。随后一名记者指出，遭到恐怖分子袭击的两家报纸之一曾收到来自亲汪精卫组织的 numerous 威胁信，信中预言如果该报不停止其反汪精卫的态度，其社址将被摧毁；而此次突袭就发生在该报刊登重庆当局谴责汪精卫先生的声明后仅几天。

被视为严重事件

当被问及日本当局是否认为此事严重时，发言人回答说，鉴于有持续报道称中国人正计划刺杀英国驻华大使阿奇博尔德·克拉克·克尔爵士（Sir Archibald Clark Kerr），以阻止英日在东京的会谈成功结束，因此事态是严重的。

“如果有任何证据表明恐怖分子与亲汪精卫团体有联系，日本当局是否会与上海公共租界工部局警务处合作，将该团伙一网打尽？”一名记者问道。

“他们必须首先证明这一点。正如反复声明的那样，日本军方当局对维持此处外侨区域的和平与秩序深感兴趣，如果发现任何元素违背这一日本政策，只要其罪行得到证实，日本方面当然会合作予以铲除。”

“关于恐怖分子受重庆政府指使的情报，您是否有更具体的内容？”一名记者问道。

“你是要问警方从哪里获得他们的情报吗？”这是他的回答。

pages.en:
22742

Hide-out in Japanese Areas
Asked whether the Japanese
authorities were aware of the fact
that the terrorists in question had
their hide-out in Japanese-occupied
territory off Edinburgh Road, the
spokesman replied in the negative.
He also denied that the Japanese
authorities had been approached by
Settlement authorities, with a view
to rounding up the gangs of armed
thugs residing in "Ta Tao" territory.
"Was not a conversation held be-
tween the Japanese Gendarmerie and
the Shanghai Municipal Police on
July 3, concerning an engagement
of the previous day when a gang
of armed men opened fire on a police
search party on Edinburgh Road?"
"The Japanese authorities have not
been informed of such conversations,"
the spokesman replied.
"Is the shooting affair on Avenue
Edward VII considered serious enough
to come under the Japanese policy
to take part in the maintenance of
peace and order in the Settlement?"
queried a correspondent.
"It is not serious in that sense but
the ramifications of the case are not
clear yet."
pages.zh:
22742

藏身于日控区

当被问及日本当局是否知晓相关恐怖分子在爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）外的日占区设有藏身之处时，发言人予以否认。他还否认了租界当局曾接触日本当局，旨在清剿居住在“大道”（Ta Tao，音译）地区的武装暴徒团伙的说法。

“7月3日，日本宪兵队与上海公共租界工部局警务处是否就前一天发生的一起事件进行过交谈？当时一伙武装人员在爱丁堡路向警方搜查队开火？”

“日本当局未获知此类谈话，”发言人回答说。

“爱多亚路的枪击事件是否被认为严重到足以纳入日本参与维持租界和平与秩序的政策范围？”一名记者问道。

“从这个意义上说并不严重，但案件的牵连关系尚不清楚。”

pages.en:
Gang Affray
Remarked On
By Japanese

Naval Spokesman Says It
Was Work Of Chiang
Men And “Reds”

ATTEMPT TO CREATE
FURTHER FRICTION

Refuting the suggestion made
in a number of newspapers that
the attack by terrorists on two
Chinese dailies on Avenue
Edward VII on Saturday even-
ing was carried out by a pro-
Wang Ching-wei group, the
Japanese Navy spokesman at
the Press Conference yesterday
evening stated that “informa-
tion obtained by the Japanese
Navy indicates that the assail-
ants in the case were acting
under the direction of the
Chungking régime and in co-
operation with Communist
elements.”

The spokesman stated that there
was no record of any request hav-
ing been made by the S.M.P. to
clear out gangsters from areas ad-
joining the Settlement.

To Discredit S.M.P.

In reply to questions on what the
objective of the assailants might
have been, he stated that it was
thought to be an attempt to create
an uproar in the Settlement and
thereby discredit the S.M.P., in
view of the British domination in
the Settlement, specially on ac-
count of the weakening of British
policy in the Far East. Continu-
ing, the spokesman said that it was
an attempt to attack several news-
papers, which had of late toned-
down on their violent anti-Japan-
ese policy.

Summing up the whole issue,
the spokesman added that it was
an attempt to create further fric-
tion between the British and
Japanese and to antagonize British
public opinion, thereby causing a
break-up in the Tokyo Conference.

Not Sufficient Evidence

When it was pointed out to the
spokesman that the paper attacked
had received threatening letters
signed by a pro-Wang Ching-wei
group, he replied that that was not
sufficient evidence.

When asked whether the incident
was considered serious by the
Japanese authorities, in view of the
previous statements made that the
Japanese would be forced to restore
peace and order in the Settlement
if disturbances broke out, the
spokesman replied that it was not
serious in that sense.

The spokesman confirmed state-
ments that, in the event of it being
proved that certain elements have
conducted themselves against the
maintenance of peace and order in
the Settlement, which runs counter
to Japanese policy, the Japanese
would take measures to suppress
them.
pages.zh:
日本评论帮派斗殴

海军发言人称系蒋介石手下和“赤色分子”所为

企图制造进一步摩擦

针对多家报纸提出的说法，即周六晚在爱多亚路对两家中文日报的恐怖袭击是由亲汪精卫团体实施的，日本海军发言人在昨日晚间的新闻发布会上予以驳斥，并表示：“日本海军获得的情报表明，本案袭击者是在‘重庆政权’的指使下行动，并与共产党元素合作。”

发言人表示，没有记录显示上海公共租界工部局警务处曾要求清除租界毗邻地区的歹徒。

旨在抹黑工部局警务处

在回答关于袭击者可能有何目的的问题时，他表示，据信这是企图在租界制造骚乱，从而抹黑由英国人主导的上海公共租界工部局警务处，特别是考虑到英国在远东政策的削弱。发言人继续说道，这也是对几家最近缓和了其激烈反日政策的报纸进行的袭击。

总结整个问题，发言人补充说，这是企图在英国人和日本人之间制造进一步的摩擦，并激起英国公众舆论的对立，从而导致东京会议破裂。

证据不足

当向发言人指出，受袭报纸曾收到由亲汪精卫团体签署的威胁信时，他回答说，这不足以作为证据。

当被问及鉴于此前声明称如果发生骚乱日本将被迫恢复租界的和平与秩序，日本当局是否认为此事严重时，发言人回答说，从这个意义上说并不严重。

发言人证实了如下说法：如果有证据证明某些元素的行为违背了维持租界和平与秩序的原则，从而与日本政策相抵触，日本将采取措施予以镇压。

pages.en:
CH
JUL 25 1939
0

Japanese Say
Chungking
Backs Attack

Saturday Shooting At
Newspaper Plant
Discussed

NEWSMEN ASK
MANY QUESTIONS

Spokesman Declares
Assault On 'News Row
Not Serious

Information obtained by
the Japanese Navy, regarding
Saturday evening's terrorist
attack on newspaper row,
Avenue Edward VII, "indi-
cates that the assailants in
the case were acting under
the direction of the 'Chung-
king regime' and are closely
affiliated with communist ele-
ments," declared the spokes-
man at yesterday's press con-
ference.

Queried on what could have
been the objective of the ter-
rorists, the spokesman said that
the matter was now being in-
vestigated by the Shanghai
Municipal Police. "It has been
suggested, however," he added,
"that it was an attempt to
create an uproar in the Inter-
national Settlement in order to
discredit the British-dominated
Shanghai Municipal Police, in
view of the weakening of the
British policy in the Far East.
"Further, it was also an attempt
to attack a number of newspapers
which in the past were violently
anti-Japanese, but had recently
moderated their tone," the spokes-
man stated.

"Unsubstantiated Opinion"
When it was pointed out that
the particular newspaper attack-
ed in Saturday's terrorist up-
heaval was the Chinese-Ameri-
can Daily News, which alone
published a Chungking denun-
ciation of Wang Ching-wei, the
spokesman replied: "That is an
unsubstantiated opinion."

To another remark that this
particular newspaper had only
recently received threatening
letters from partisans of Wang
Ching-wei, he said: "There is
not sufficient evidence to prove
this."

The spokesman answered that he
was not in a position to discuss
"the views of the Shanghai Muni-
cipal Police or anybody else," when
a correspondent said he believed
the police had evidence that the
same weapons were used in Satur-
day's affray as had been used on
June 16, in an attack which had
been definitely established as hav-
ing been made by pro-Wang groups.

CH
1939年7月25日
0

日方称重庆支持袭击

讨论周六报社枪击案

记者提出诸多问题

发言人宣称对“报馆街”的袭击并不严重

日本海军发言人在昨日的新闻发布会上宣布，日本海军获得的关于周六晚在爱多亚路“报馆街”发生的恐怖袭击的情报，“表明本案袭击者是在‘重庆政权’的指使下行动，并与共产党元素有着密切关联。”

当被问及恐怖分子的目的可能是什么时，发言人表示，上海公共租界工部局警务处目前正在调查此事。“不过，”他补充说，“有人提出，这是企图在国际租界制造骚乱，以抹黑由英国人主导的上海公共租界工部局警务处，鉴于英国在远东政策的削弱。”

“此外，这也是对几家过去激烈反日但最近缓和了语气的报纸进行的袭击，”发言人 stated。

“未经证实的观点”

当有人指出，在周六的恐怖动荡中受袭的特定报纸是《中美日报》，该报是唯一刊登重庆方面谴责汪精卫内容的报纸时，发言人回答说：“这是一种未经证实的观点。”

对于另一项评论，即该报最近才收到来自汪精卫支持者的威胁信，他说：“没有足够的证据来证明这一点。”

当一名记者表示他相信警方有证据表明，周六斗殴中使用的武器与6月16日一起已被确定为由亲汪团体发动的袭击中使用的武器相同时，发言人回答说他无法讨论“上海公共租界工部局警务处或任何其他方的观点”。

pages.en:
"Do You Ask Police?"
A question whether the navy
spokesman could give more concrete
evidence than the mere statement
that the Japanese authorities had
indication that the "assailants were
acting under the direction of the
'Chungking regime,'" was answered
by the query: "Do you ask the
police where they secure their infor-
mation?"
A correspondent then strove
to discover whether, at least, the
information in the possession of
the Japanese navy was purely
Japanese or whether it was cor-
roborated by the Shanghai
Municipal Police. This query
elicited the answer: "That is one
of the essential secrets."
The spokesman said the Japan-
ese authorities had no information
that the terrorists had come from
the "Badlands" area. He declared
that "in view of the persistent re-
ports that Chinese element planned
to kill Sir Archibald Clark Kerr in
order to cause such an uproar of
British public opinion that no
agreement in Tokyo could be reach-
ed, one was led to the impression
that terrorists disturbed peace and
order in the Settlement to create
friction between the Settlement
authorities and the Japanese."
"Not Serious"
A correspondent, asking whether
the Japanese regarded the assault
on news row as serious, reminded
the spokesman that he had said re-
cently that the Japanese might be
forced to take over the Interna-
tional Settlement in the event of a
"serious" incident occurring.
In reply, the spokesman stated
that Saturday night's attack was
"not serious in that sense at all."
He added that "its ramifications
are not yet clear."
Fourth Death
Meanwhile, the fourth victim of
Saturday night's outbreak of ter-
rorism died in the St. Elizabeth
Hospital yesterday morning. She
was Chen Woo-sz, 39-year-old native
of Ningpo, who was wounded in the
right shoulder during the shooting
affray in the Louza district.
Police of the two foreign-admin-
istered areas, meanwhile, were tak-
ing extraordinary precautions
against a recurrence of the out-
break on newspaper row. The
French Police stationed two mobile
steel blockhouses at the corner of
Avenue Edward VII and Rue Mon-
tauban. They also erected barbed
wire barricades on Avenue Haig in
the vicinity of Edinburgh Road,
believed to be a thickly-infested
gunmen's nest. Shanghai Municipal
Police were stationed on the other
side of the street.
Death Toll Mounts
In addition to 20 wounded, includ-
ing, a Polish taxi-dancer of the
Palais Cafe, 19-year-old Nellie Schi-
kinskaya, four have so far succumb-
ed of their wounds.
These include Captain A. F. "Tug"
Wilson, American, 47, proprietor of
the New Ritz Bar, who unarmed,
attempted to stop the gunmen;
Wong Shi-wen, 45, shot in the back
and abdomen in the composition
room of the British-owned China
Evening News; Chin Chei-chung,
50-year-old coolie, killed when the
gunmen entered and shot at random
in the building at 150 Avenue Edward
VII, where the two Chinese dailies
are located, and Chen Woo-sz, 39-
year-old Chinese woman who was
wounded subsequently during the
shooting in the Louza District.
pages.zh:
“你问警察吗？”
针对海军发言人能否提供比仅仅声称日本当局有迹象表明“袭击者是在‘重庆政权’的指使下行动”更具体证据的提问，得到的回答是反问：“你去问警察他们是从哪里获取情报的吗？”
随后，一名记者试图查明，日本海军掌握的情报究竟是纯粹来自日本方面，还是得到了上海公共租界工部局警务处的证实。这一询问得到的回答是：“那是核心机密之一。”
该发言人称，日本当局没有情报显示恐怖分子来自“坏地方”（Badlands）区域。他宣称，“鉴于持续有报告称中国分子计划刺杀阿奇博尔德·克拉克·克尔爵士（Sir Archibald Clark Kerr），以引起英国舆论的强烈哗然，致使在东京无法达成任何协议，这使人产生一种印象，即恐怖分子扰乱租界的和平与秩序，旨在制造租界当局与日本之间的摩擦。”
“不严重”
一名记者在提问时提醒发言人，他最近曾表示，如果发生“严重”事件，日本可能被迫接管国际租界，并询问日本方面是否认为此次对报馆街的袭击是严重的。
作为回应，发言人表示，周六晚间的袭击“在那种意义上根本不严重”。他补充说，“其波及范围尚不清楚。”
第四名死者
与此同时，周六晚间恐怖主义爆发中的第四名受害者于昨晨在圣伊丽莎白医院（St. Elizabeth Hospital）去世。她是陈伍氏（Chen Woo-sz），39岁，宁波人，在老闸区（Louza district）的枪战事件中右肩受伤。
与此同时，两个外籍管理区域的警方正在采取非凡的预防措施，以防报馆街再次发生此类爆发事件。法国巡捕在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）与蒙陶班路（Rue Montauban）的拐角处部署了两座移动式钢制堡垒。他们还在海格路（Avenue Haig）靠近爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）的地段设置了铁丝网路障，据信那里是枪手密集藏匿的巢穴。上海公共租界工部局警务处的警员则部署在街道的另一侧。
死亡人数增加
除20名伤者外——其中包括帕莱咖啡馆（Palais Cafe）的一名19岁波兰籍舞女内莉·希金斯卡娅（Nellie Schikinskaya）——迄今已有四人因伤不治身亡。
死者包括：47岁的美国人A. F. “塔格”·威尔逊（A. F. "Tug" Wilson），新丽都酒吧（New Ritz Bar）老板，他在未携带武器的情况下试图阻止枪手；45岁的黄世文（Wong Shi-wen，音译），在英商《字林西报》晚刊（China Evening News）的排版室背部和腹部中弹；50岁的苦力陈其忠（Chin Chei-chung，音译），当枪手进入爱多亚路150号大楼（两家中文日报所在地）并随意开枪射击时遇害；以及39岁的中国妇女陈伍氏（Chen Woo-sz），她在老闸区的枪战中随后受伤。

pages.en:
Arraigned In Court
Accused of participating in Satur-
day's terroristic activities, three of
the six suspects arrested by police
were brought before the First Spe-
cial District Court yesterday. Mr.
Paul Y. Ru, municipal advocate,
was in charge of the prosecution.
It was revealed at yesterday's
court session that two of the three
men had previous conviction re-
cords, one of the two having been
convicted on criminal charges no
less than 10 times, it was stated.
The prisoners gave their names as
Shen Yu-fei, 26, Kompo; Woo Yih-
wei, 29, Canton, and Ting Yung-
seng, 29, Chekiang. Shen stood
tamely in the prisoners' dock, still
wearing his blood-stained suit while
Ting's head was bandaged for a
minor wound.
After presenting the facts of the
case, Mr. Ru requested the court to
adjourn the case for two weeks,
pending the recovery of three other
suspects who were being treated in
the Police Hospital.
pages.zh:
法庭提审
因涉嫌参与周六的恐怖活动，警方逮捕的六名嫌疑人中的三人于昨日被带至第一特区地方法院受审。市检察官陆文权（Paul Y. Ru，音译）先生负责公诉。
在昨日的庭审中透露，这三名男子中有两人有前科记录，据称其中一人曾因刑事指控被判罪不下十次。
囚犯自报姓名为：沈玉飞（Shen Yu-fei，音译），26岁，广东人；吴义伟（Woo Yih-wei，音译），29岁，广东人；丁永生（Ting Yung-seng，音译），29岁，浙江人。沈玉飞顺从地站在被告席上，仍穿着那件沾满血迹的衣服，而丁永生的头部因轻伤缠着绷带。
在陈述案件事实后，陆检察官请求法院将案件延期两周审理，以待另外三名正在警务处医院接受治疗的嫌疑人康复。

pages.en:
SHAN

JUL 2 1959

Arrests Made By Police
In Wake Of Saturday's
Outburst Of Terrorism

Extensive Searching And Investigations Are Being
Conducted; Casualty List Totals Three Dead
And Twenty Wounded, Including Gangsters

HEROISM OF CHINESE CONSTABLES;
MUCH SYMPATHY FOR VICTIMS

Further investigations made yesterday by the Shanghai
Municipal Police into Saturday night's bloody skirmish, in
which no fewer than 100 shots were fired and several hand
grenades thrown in the terrorist shooting and bombing affray,
costing the lives of three persons and injuring 17 others, includ-
ing a foreign woman, adjacent to "The Shanghai Times" building,
160 Avenue Edward VII, reveal an attempt made to execute one
of the boldest plots of destruction in this city for many years.

It would appear from all inquiries made yesterday by this
journal that the terrorist gang actually had as their objective
the destruction of all the Chinese newspapers in the vicinity,
namely, the "China Evening News," (Ta Wan Pao) and the
"Chinese-American Daily News," (Chung Mei Jih Pao), only
the instantaneous and exemplary manner in which the Chinese
constables acted at the special post outside the building prevent-
ed this disaster.

Landing on the scene in four or
five hire cars, the gangsters, who
numbered more than 20, presum-
ably from the badlands, entered the
building from the alleyway and secur-
ed entrance through a side doorway.
Eye-witnesses state that the mob
first ordered the chauffeurs to park
the cars near Kiangse Road, where
they had presumably posted look-
outs to watch for the police. Prior
to entering the building when they
broke up into groups, the party
seized a C.P.C. and disarmed him
of his .308 Colt automatic pistol,
while the others passed to gain ad-
mittance. Inside the building, the
groups entered various floors,
where they intended to ex-
ecute their well planned
mission, when they encounter-
ed some apparently overlooked ob-
stacle making a hitch in the plot,
and one of the group commenced
to fire.
pages.zh:
SHAN

1959年7月2日

警方在周六恐怖主义爆发后实施逮捕

正在进行广泛搜查和调查；伤亡名单总计三人死亡，二十人受伤，其中包括帮派分子

中国巡捕的英勇行为；对受害者寄予极大同情

上海公共租界工部局警务处昨日对周六晚间的血腥冲突进行了进一步调查。在那场恐怖主义的枪击和炸弹袭击事件中，发射了不少于100发子弹，并投掷了数枚手榴弹，造成三人死亡，17人受伤，其中包括一名外籍妇女，事发地点位于爱多亚路160号《上海泰晤士报》（The Shanghai Times）大楼附近。调查揭示了一起企图执行本市多年来最大胆的破坏阴谋的行动。

根据本报昨日进行的所有查询来看，恐怖团伙的实际目标似乎是摧毁附近的所有中文报纸，即《字林西报》晚刊（Ta Wan Pao，注：此处原文英文对应中文名可能有误，通常China Evening News指《字林西报》晚刊，但括号内拼音为Ta Wan Pao即《大晚报》，译者依原文保留括号内容）和《中美日报》（Chung Mei Jih Pao）。正是由于在大楼外特别岗哨上的中国巡捕反应迅速且处置得当，才防止了这场灾难的发生。

这群暴徒人数超过20人，据推测来自“坏地方”（badlands），乘坐四五辆出租车抵达现场，从巷弄进入大楼，并通过侧门入口进入。目击者称，这伙人首先命令司机将车停在江西路（Kiangse Road）附近，他们可能在那里安排了望风人员以监视警察。在进入大楼之前，当他们分散成小组时，该伙人制服了一名中国巡捕（C.P.C.），并缴获了他的一支.308口径柯尔特自动手枪，而其他成员则趁机进入。在大楼内部，各小组进入不同楼层，准备执行他们精心策划的任务，此时他们遇到了一些显然被忽视的障碍，导致计划出现波折，其中一组人员开始开火。

pages.en:
Fire On Chinese Police

Being broken up and firing having commenced, members of the groups, fearing capture, discarded the idea of bombing and thought only of making a safe get-away. Three C.P.C.'s stationed outside the buildings No's 1519, 1472 and 1095, the latter being a plain clothes man who had only been on the Force a few months, challenged the first escaping group who immediately fired on them. The policemen drew their pistols and returned the fire, but the three of them were seriously wounded. The other groups escaped from the building, firing their way out, and heading west to Kiangse Road to their awaiting cars.

In the dramatic escape there was a continuous burst of fire, with bullets whizzing everywhere. The gangsters are reported to have been actually running and firing shots to the rear, over their shoulders. No attempt was made to select any particular persons, the fleeing gunmen merely shooting at anyone whom they saw.

Some of the gang are said to have run to the French Concession, discarding their weapons and bombs on the run. French police on Avenue Edward VII opened fire from their post outside the Palais Cabart; at the fleeing gunmen. Bullets landed in the side of buildings and motor cars and ricocheted on the street.

Hail Of Shots Meet Bus

Turning the corner and making for Kiangse Road the gunmen let fly a hail of bullets into railless trolley cars, several bullets piercing the bodies. The driver of rail-less tram, No. B. 357 was seriously wounded and had a very narrow escape from death as the bullets entered the front of his bus while it was proceeding to make the turn at the corner of Avenue Edward VII.

A bomb thrown on Kiangse Road might have been intended for Police Constable No. 1580, who was on duty at the intersection of Canton and Kiangse Road. At least, the bomb was thrown at this point. Much firing took place along Kiangse Road, as evidenced from the number of empty cartridge cases and ammunition clips, all bright and practically new, from automatic weapons.

Abandoned Car Found

The gangsters, who had not disappeared elsewhere, now made a get-away in two cars. One of these cars was later found abandoned on Avenue Foch near Avenue du Roi Albert. The other car proceeded on Kiangse Road and up Hankow Road in its get-away when it encountered the search party from Louza district as reported fully in yesterday's account of the outrage.

When the Louza district search party of the S.M.P., operating on Hankow Road, near Chekiang Road, observed this car, they challenged it. Instead of stopping, the car accelerated, ignoring the police command, and opened fire on the party. The police promptly returned the fire on the car, several shots hitting the machine. Police are of the opinion that the driver was intimidated, one of the gang having put a gun in his back and told him to "step on the gas," since challenging is not ignored by chauffeurs.

This machine stopped, however, with men alighting and fleeing in different directions, firing from mauser pistols, with the police continuing the chase. Seven or eight are reported to have been injured in the Louza incident.
pages.zh:
向中国警察开火

由于队伍被打散且开火已经开始，各组人员因害怕被捕，放弃了轰炸的念头，只想着安全逃脱。部署在1519号、1472号和1095号大楼外的三名中国巡捕（C.P.C.'s）——最后一名是便衣警察，加入警队仅几个月——对第一组逃跑者提出警告，后者立即向他们开火。警察拔出手枪还击，但这三人均受重伤。其他小组从大楼逃出，边开枪边突围，向西逃往江西路他们等候的车辆处。

在这场戏剧性的逃亡中，枪声不断，子弹四处飞窜。据报道，暴徒们实际上是一边奔跑，一边向身后肩膀上方开枪。他们没有试图选择特定目标，逃亡的枪手只是向他们看到的任何人射击。

据说部分团伙成员跑进了法租界，在逃跑途中丢弃了武器和炸弹。法租界警察在爱多亚路从帕莱卡巴特酒店（Palais Cabart）外的岗哨向逃亡的枪手开火。子弹击中建筑物侧面和汽车，并在街道上反弹。

密集弹雨袭向公交车

枪手转过拐角冲向江西路时，向无轨电车倾泻了一阵雨点般的子弹，几颗子弹穿透车身。B.357号无轨电车的司机身受重伤，死里逃生，因为当他驾驶公交车行至爱多亚路拐角准备转弯时，子弹击中了车头。

一枚扔在江西路上的炸弹可能是针对1580号巡捕的，他当时正在广东路与江西路的交叉口执勤。至少，炸弹就是在这个位置被投掷的。江西路沿线发生了大量枪战，现场发现的大量空弹壳和弹夹证明了这一点，这些弹壳和弹夹都光亮如新，几乎未使用过，来自自动武器。

发现弃车

尚未在其他地方消失的暴徒现在乘坐两辆车逃离。其中一辆车后来被发现遗弃在福煦路（Avenue Foch）靠近阿尔贝国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）的地方。另一辆车在逃亡过程中沿江西路行驶，然后转入汉口路，正如昨日对这起暴行的详细报道所述，它在那里遇到了来自老闸区的搜捕队。

当上海公共租界工部局警务处老闸区搜捕队在浙江路附近的汉口路上行动时，发现了这辆车，并对其提出警告。该车非但没有停车，反而加速行驶，无视警察的命令，并向搜捕队开火。警察立即向汽车还击，几发子弹击中车辆。警方认为司机受到了胁迫，因为一名团伙成员用枪顶着他的背，命令他“踩油门”，毕竟司机通常不会无视警告。

然而，这辆车最终停了下来，车上人员下车向不同方向逃窜，并使用毛瑟手枪射击，警察继续追捕。据报道，在老闸区事件中有七八人受伤。

pages.en:
Several Suspects Held

The Shanghai Municipal police
have had little rest since the com-
mencement of the outrage. Both
foreign and Chinese detectives have
been searching likely places where
the gunmen might possibly hide
out. It is known that the police
have several suspects in custody,
but they are not inclined to re-
lease any information whatsoever
on what arrests have been made
or who they are. Arrests have
been made of participants in both
of the shooting affrays. Careful
scrutiny to uncover evidence in
connection with the case is being
carried on extensively, while
other police are checking up on
their files of descriptions of gang-
sters.
Whether or not the French
have made arrests so far could
not be ascertained.

Expression Of Sorrow

Chinese throughout the Settlement
and Concession express deep
sympathy for the unfortunate
victims of one of the boldest out-
rages committed within the Settle-
ment in recent years. The unfortun-
ate wounded, caught in the burning
gunfire when the horrifying shooting
commenced, were carrying out their
daily functions and perhaps en-
deavouring to keep cool on the busy
sidewalks of Avenue Edward VII,
which is full of activity from early
morning until late at night, and
totally unaware of the fright-
ful terroristic outrage that
was to entangle them. The
indiscriminate firing came with
such dramatic suddenness that they
had little or no chance of protection.
Those who were in the vicinity at
the time who escaped death and in-
jury tell all sorts of stories of the
startling fright and the unforeseen
circumstances in which they were
placed. How fate saved each partic-
ular individual from being struck
by any of the blazing bullets that
whizzed in all directions in the
street, was a subject of much dis-
cussion yesterday. Eye-witnesses
testify to the scattering and mad
dashes for cover amid great con-
fusion by the throngs of humanity
on Avenue Edward VII at the time.

Bullet Holes And Ricochets

In the course of investigations yes-
terday, crowds of Chinese watched
police photographing the scenes of
the outrages, and including in their
street photographs shop windows
which bore mute evidence
of the previous night's shoot-
ing. The wholesale and
retail wine shop of Zung
Lee and Company, located on the
corner of Avenue Edward VII and
Kiangse Road, had four bullet holes
in its large front windows and
frames, while a corner of the door
showed the evidence of a ricochet
bullet having glanced off and pierc-
ed a window. Bits of glass were
sprinkled amidst the many cherry
brandy bottles in the window, none
of which happened to have been
broken.
The large front window of the
Lee Chun Chang, rug antique shop,
at 38 Kiangse Road, had a large
hole in the window which apparent-
ly was made by a rebounding pro-
jectile.
A bullet cut a hole in the win-
dow of the Linotype and Machinery
Company, located on the ground
floor beneath "The Shanghai Times,"
while dried blood pools in the door-
way entrance to the offices show-
ed where a wounded victim had
evidently lay down to take shelter.
Traces of blood were evident on
other parts of the street which
passing Chinese in the day stopped
to notice.
Examination reveals bullet holes
in windows leading to "The Shang-
hai Times" offices which evidently
had been made by ricochets and
bullets fired from the lane adjacent
to the building. No other harm to
the building was done or machinery
damaged.
pages.zh:
多名嫌疑人被拘

自暴行发生以来，上海公共租界警务处几乎未曾停歇。外籍与华籍侦探一直在搜寻枪手可能藏匿的可疑地点。据悉，警方已拘留数名嫌疑人，但他们不愿透露任何关于逮捕行动或嫌疑人身份的信息。两起枪击事件的参与者均已被捕。目前正广泛展开细致的审查工作以 uncover 与案件有关的证据，同时其他警员正在核对档案中关于帮派人物的描述记录。

至于法租界方面是否已实施逮捕，目前尚无法查明。

哀悼之情

公共租界及法租界的华人对近年来租界内发生的最为大胆的暴行之一的不幸受害者表达了深切的同情。当骇人的枪击开始时，这些不幸的伤者正身处燃烧的枪火之中，他们当时正在履行日常事务，或许正努力在从清晨到深夜都充满活力的爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）繁忙的人行道上保持镇定，完全 unaware 即将卷入其中的可怕恐怖暴行。 indiscriminate 的射击来得如此突然且具戏剧性，使他们几乎没有或根本没有机会寻求保护。当时在附近幸免于死伤的人们讲述了各种关于他们所遭遇的惊人恐惧和不可预见情况的故事。昨天，人们热议的话题是，命运如何让每一个特定个体免遭街道上四处飞窜的炽热子弹的击中。目击者证实，当时爱多亚路上的人群在巨大的混乱中四散奔逃，疯狂地寻找掩护。

弹孔与跳弹

在昨天的调查过程中，成群的中国民众围观警察拍摄暴行现场的照片，这些街道照片包括了那些无声见证前夜枪击事件的商店橱窗。位于爱多亚路与江西路（Kiangse Road）拐角处的“宗利公司”（Zung Lee and Company，音译）批发兼零售酒行，其大型前窗及窗框上有四个弹孔，而门的一角则显示出一颗跳弹擦过并击穿窗户的痕迹。橱窗内许多樱桃白兰地酒瓶之间散落着玻璃碎片，所幸没有一个酒瓶破碎。

位于江西路38号的“李春昌”（Lee Chun Chang，音译）地毯古董店的大型前窗上有一个大洞，显然是由反弹的投射物造成的。

一颗子弹在位于《上海泰晤士报》（The Shanghai Times）楼下底层的“莱诺铸排机与机械公司”（Linotype and Machinery Company）的窗户上打出了一个洞，而办公室入口门道处的干涸血泊显示，一名受伤受害者显然曾躺在那里寻求掩护。街道的其他部分也有明显的血迹，白天路过的中国人驻足观看。

检查显示，通往《上海泰晤士报》办公室的窗户上有弹孔，这些弹孔显然是由跳弹以及从大楼相邻弄堂内射出的子弹造成的。大楼本身未受其他损害，机器也未受损。

pages.en:
The following is the complete
casualty list of the Chinese killed
and injured in the outrage both on
Avenue Edward VII and Hankow
Road.
Weng Shi-wen, 45, killed. Shot
in back and abdomen in compos-
ing room on the British owned
"China Evening News" by gunmen
who plotted destruction of this
Chinese language journal.
Chin Chei-shung, 50 coolie, killed.
Employed by the Tung Trust Com-
pany, 150 Avenue Edward VII.
Gunmen went into premises and
fired at random.
Chang Hun-chin, 42, wounded,
native of Zaushing, now resident of
Shanghai, coolie. Shrapnel wound
in left side of back. Lester Chinese
Hospital.
Police Constable No. 1518, wound-
ed right leg, detained Police Hos-
pital.
Police Constable No. 1472, wound-
ed right leg, detained Police Hos-
pital.
Police Constable No. 1895, bullet
wound in right knee, detained at
Police Hospital.
Hu Li-ying, 17, female, wounded
right leg. Resided at 24 Kiangse
Road. Under constant treatment, not
detained in hospital.
Zee Ling-nyech, 18, native of
Shantung, abrasion left knee, resid-
ence 45 Kiangse Road, St. Luke's
Hospital, not being detained. Under
treatment.
Han Ping-tsang, driver of rail-
less trolley car B. 357, wounded
left thigh as bullet entered front
of bus proceeding to Avenue Ed-
ward VII. Very narrow escape.
Police Hospital, not detained, un-
der treatment.
Kao Ching-zai, 28, native of Sze-
chwan, coolie, non-resident of
Shanghai, bullet wound left face.
Yih Yeong-kai, 38, native of Foo-
chow. Bullet wound in chest. Non-
resident. Lester Chinese Hospital.
Wu Ki-yuan, 38, richa coolie.
Wounded shoulder and right leg
and chest. Lester Chinese Hospital.
Residence, 23 Rue Bourgeat.
Ku Sing-zee, 35, native of Soo-
chow, compositor, employed by
"China Evening News." Bullet
wound left arm and back. Lester
Chinese Hospital.
Kao Zang-loh, 36, native of
Shantung, residence 10 Hung Yih
Lee, Kiangse Road. Bullet wound
right thigh. Paulun' Hospital.
Yu Yao-bang, 7, male infant,
native of Hangchow. Residence 130
Avenue Edward VII. Felt from
shock and fright during shooting
affray. Fractures.
Chang S. Tsung, 32, Non-resident.
Left arm and back. Native of
Kompo.
Chang Ping-wu, 18, native of
Kompo, residence 616 Hankow Road.
Bullet wound left elbow.
Tai Tsi-shing, 24, native of Kompo.
Bullet wound abdomen. Police Hos-
pital.
Lee Wei-ling, 56, Cantonese. Haw-
ker. Bullet wound right thigh,
residence 618 Hankow Road, St.
Luke's Hospital.
Ting Yoong-sung, 39, native of

pages.zh:
以下是此次暴行中在爱多亚路和汉口路（Hankow Road）遇害及受伤的华人完整伤亡名单。

翁世文（Weng Shi-wen），45岁，遇害。在英商所有的《中国晚报》（China Evening News）排版室中，背部和腹部中弹，凶手是策划摧毁这份中文报刊的枪手。

金其松（Chin Chei-shung，音译），50岁，苦力，遇害。受雇于爱多亚路150号的通益信托公司（Tung Trust Company，音译）。枪手闯入 premises 并随意开枪。

张洪金（Chang Hun-chin，音译），42岁，受伤，浙江绍兴人，现居上海，苦力。左背部受弹片伤。送莱斯特华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital）。

第1518号巡捕，右腿受伤，留治于警务处医院。

第1472号巡捕，右腿受伤，留治于警务处医院。

第1895号巡捕，右膝中弹，留治于警务处医院。

胡丽英（Hu Li-ying，音译），17岁，女性，右腿受伤。住江西路24号。接受持续治疗，未住院。

谢林业（Zee Ling-nyech，音译），18岁，山东人，左膝擦伤，住江西路45号，圣路加医院（St. Luke's Hospital），未住院。接受治疗。

韩平藏（Han Ping-tsang，音译），无轨电车B.357号司机，左大腿受伤，当时子弹射入正驶往爱多亚路的公交车前部。死里逃生。送警务处医院，未住院，接受治疗。

高景哉（Kao Ching-zai，音译），28岁，四川人，苦力，非上海居民，左面部中弹。

叶永开（Yih Yeong-kai，音译），38岁，福州人。胸部中弹。非本地居民。送莱斯特华人医院。

吴启元（Wu Ki-yuan，音译），38岁，人力车夫。肩部、右腿及胸部受伤。送莱斯特华人医院。住址：蒲石路（Rue Bourgeat）23号。

顾星子（Ku Sing-zee，音译），35岁，苏州人，排字工，受雇于《中国晚报》。左臂及背部中弹。送莱斯特华人医院。

高藏洛（Kao Zang-loh，音译），36岁，山东人，住江西路宏义里（Hung Yih Lee，音译）10号。右大腿中弹。送宝隆医院（Paulun' Hospital）。

姚耀邦（Yu Yao-bang，音译），7岁，男婴，杭州人。住爱多亚路130号。在枪击事件中因震惊和恐惧而感到不适。骨折。

张S.宗（Chang S. Tsung，音译），32岁，非本地居民。左臂及背部受伤。广东人（Kompo，原文拼写疑似Canton之误或特定地名，此处依原文音译为康波/广东）。

张平武（Chang Ping-wu，音译），18岁，广东人（Kompo），住汉口路616号。左肘中弹。

戴志成（Tai Tsi-shing，音译），24岁，广东人（Kompo）。腹部中弹。送警务处医院。

李伟玲（Lee Wei-ling，音译），56岁，广东人。小贩。右大腿中弹，住汉口路618号，送圣路加医院。

丁永松（Ting Yoong-sung，音译），39岁，镇江人。小贩。非上海居民。头皮中弹。

陈伍氏（Chen Woo Sz，音译），38岁，女性。宁波人。右侧身体中弹。住汉口路622号，送圣伊丽莎白医院（St. Elizabeth's Hospital）。

朱佩玲（Chu Pei-ling，音译），32岁，非本地居民。右腿及右脚中弹，送宝隆医院。

pages.en:
Polish Girl's Wound
Not Serious

Miss Nelly Schikinskaya, 19-
year-old Polish girl, employed at
the Palais Cafe, who was wound-
ed in the knee as she alighted
from a No. 21 French Concession
omnibus on Avenue Edward VII,
and Kiangse Road at 8.40 p.m.
on Saturday, the time of the
shooting affray, is reported to be
recovering and her wounds are
not serious. She is in the Rus-
sian Orthodox Hospital receiving
treatment.
pages.zh:
波兰女孩伤势
不严重

19岁的波兰女孩内莉·希金斯卡娅小姐（Miss Nelly Schikinskaya），受雇于宫殿咖啡馆（Palais Cafe），周六晚8点40分枪击事件发生时，她正从一辆行驶在爱多亚路与江西路口的21路法租界公共汽车上下来，膝盖受伤。据报道，她正在康复中，伤势并不严重。她目前在东正教医院（Russian Orthodox Hospital）接受治疗。

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS.

JUL 24 1930

Pro-Wang Group Seen Behind
Saturday's Attacks

Great Bravery Shown by Wilson, Police Officers in
Fighting Overwhelming Odds ; Investigations On

WITH eleven potato-masher type hand-grenades, six brand
new automatic Mauser pistols and some 200 empty cartridge
cases in their possession as a result of the terrorist coup staged
on Avenue Edward VII on Saturday evening, a squad of detectives
from Central and Louza Stations worked throughout yesterday
and last night, questioning suspects, witnesses and policemen on
the scene at the time, in an endeavour to reconstruct the coup
which, as far as could be ascertained was well organized but
ended in failure.

Now that the smoke has somewhat
cleared, it becomes apparent that
apart from the 20 men who arrived
in four Ford taxis at Kiangse Road
shortly before 8.15 p.m. on Saturday,
a large number of members of the
same gang and so-called "look-see"
men were stationed at various strate-
gic points to cover up every police-
man stationed in the vicinity.

The group of terrorists divided up
into three gangs as they entered
Chang Keng Li, 130 Avenue Edward
VII, next to the "Shanghai Times"
building, where the premises housing
the "China Evening News" a British-
owned Chinese language publication,
and the "Chinese-American Daily
News" an American owned news-
paper are situated. The printing
plant of the "China Press" is also
stated to be in the same house.

The obvious intention of the gun-
men must have been to create a gen-
eral confusion in the building in
question, to shoot everybody in sight
and to destroy as much as possible
of the machinery with a view to
preventing the publications from ap-
pearing again. More than ten of the
terrorists entered the premises of the
"China Evening News" which are
situated on the first floor of the build-
ing in question, whilst an equal num-
ber attempted to enter the offices of
the "Chinese American Daily News"
on the next floor, although they were
prevented from doing so by a locked
door.

Whilst the first party fired a large
number of shots, killing one of the
Chinese type-setters and the second
party opened fire on the stairway,
another party entered the premises of
the Tung Wei Trust Co., at 150
Avenue Edward VII, the offices of
which face the building housing the
two Chinese papers and killed an
aged tea boy employed there who
gallantly attempted to close the door
on the armed party.

Gunmen Retreat

Meanwhile however, panic betook
the various gunmen who beat a hasty
retreat into the alley towards
Avenue Edward VII, firing into the
air as they ran and waving their
hand-grenades of which one had
already been thrown whilst another
exploded in front of the "Shanghai
Times" building.
pages.zh:
《字林西报》

1930年7月24日

亲汪派系被视为周六袭击幕后黑手

威尔逊及警员在寡不敌众的战斗中表现出极大勇气；调查正在进行中

侦探们在周六晚间爱多亚路发生的恐怖政变中缴获了11枚木柄手榴弹、6支崭新的毛瑟自动手枪以及约200个空弹壳。来自中央巡捕房和老闸巡捕房的一组侦探昨天及昨晚通宵工作，讯问当时的嫌疑人、目击者和警察，试图重构这次据查组织严密但以失败告终的政变。

现在硝烟稍散，情况变得明显：除了周六晚8点15分前不久乘坐四辆福特出租车抵达江西路的20人外，同一帮派的大量成员以及所谓的“望风”人员部署在各个战略要点，以监视该地区的每一名警察。

这伙恐怖分子进入位于爱多亚路130号、紧邻《上海泰晤士报》大楼的张庚里（Chang Keng Li，音译）时，分成了三组。该处设有英商所有的中文出版物《中国晚报》和美商所有的报纸《中美日报》（Chinese-American Daily News）。据说《大陆报》（China Press）的印刷厂也设在这栋楼内。

枪手的明显意图必定是在该大楼内制造普遍混乱，射杀视线内的所有人，并尽可能破坏机器，以防止这些刊物再次出版。十多名恐怖分子进入了位于该大楼二楼的《中国晚报》办公处，而同样数量的人试图进入下一层的《中美日报》办公室，但因门锁着而未能得逞。

当第一组人大量开枪，打死一名华籍排字工人，第二组人向楼梯间开火时，另一组人进入了位于爱多亚路150号的通威信托公司（Tung Wei Trust Co.，音译）的办公处，该公司的办公室正对着这两家中文报社所在的大楼。他们打死了一名在那里工作的年迈茶房，这位茶房曾英勇地试图将武装歹徒关在门外。

枪手撤退

然而与此同时，恐慌笼罩了各路枪手，他们仓皇撤向通往爱多亚路的弄堂，边跑边向空中开枪，并挥舞着手榴弹，其中一枚已被投出，另一枚则在《上海泰晤士报》大楼前爆炸。

pages.en:
Many of the terrorists escaped into
the French Concession where arms
and ammunition were found on
various streets, whilst most of the
men ran into Kiangse Road, where a
third hand-grenade was thrown and
where one party at least boarded
their car which was to take them
back to the "badlands" but which
actually landed them in the hands of
a police search party operating on
Hankow Road.

Of the four motor cars occupied
by the gangsters, two were found
abandoned in the French Concession,
whilst the third came to grief on
Hankow Road where five police
bullets put it out of commission.

By the modus operandi deployed in
Saturday's coup, there seems to be
no doubt that the gangsters are those
who attempted a similar coup at the
editorial offices of "The Morning
Leader", 130 Ningpo Road on June
16, when, it will be recalled, police
watchmen were also disarmed whilst
a number of shots were fired and a
dud hand-grenade thrown. It seems
furthermore established that the
hand-grenades used by the gang on
Saturday are of the same lot as the
two found on Nanking Road on the
morning of July 16, where they had
probably been discarded by terrorists
who decided at the last moment that
it was too dangerous to throw them.
Meanwhile, the large number of
suspects have been carefully ques-
tioned and, whilst police officials in
charge of the case refuse to release
any information yesterday concerning
the shoot-ups, it was understood that
only four suspects are still being
detained, most of them with previous
criminal records and all natives of
Kompo, a district known for gunmen
and other criminals.

Deeds of Bravery

But if Saturday's incident caused a
stir, it also was a demonstration of
bravery as rarely witnessed before
in this city.

Mr. A. F. "Tug" Wilson who died
at 9.30 p.m. on Saturday as a result
of a gun-shot wound sustained in the
region of the heart, was attending
customers in his establishment across
the street from the scene of the
shooting, at the time. He made a
dash for the door in an endeavour to
cross the street and to assist the
police, being prevented from doing
so by a friend who advised him to
stay under cover and not to risk
being shot. Wilson however was able
to release himself from the firm grip
of his friend and dashed towards the
alley. When he had almost arrived
there, 15 shots in his direction
rang out. Wilson, mortally injured
summoned his last bit of strength
and attempted to dash across to his
establishment, only to collapse in the
middle of the roadway. A French
soldier then crawled towards the in-
jured man and at great personal risk
managed to get him on to the French
side of the street where he was
rushed to hospital in an ambulance.

A Chinese detective who was at
the scene at the time, continued to
fire at the escaping gunmen after he
himself had already been hit and lay
in the gutter and there was a distinct
possibility of his being shot by the
police. With one finger on the trigger
however and the other hand display-
ing his detective badge, he continued
to fire until the criminals had dis-
appeared and he was rushed to the
hospital.

Inspector W. H. Widdowson, who
was near the scene at the time, also
risked his life by running into the
alley and arresting one of the
suspects at present being held, al-
though the latter had a hand-grenade
in one hand and a Mauser pistol in
the other.

shoot-up, Probationary Sergeant

许多恐怖分子逃入法租界，在各条街道上发现了武器和弹药，而大部分人则跑进江西路，在那里投掷了第三枚手榴弹，其中至少有一伙人登上了原本打算将他们带回“歹地”（badlands）的汽车，但这辆车实际上使他们落入了在汉口路行动的警方搜捕队手中。

匪徒占据的四辆汽车中，有两辆被发现弃置于法租界，第三辆则在汉口路遭到重创，五发警用子弹使其瘫痪。

从周六此次突袭的行动手法来看，毫无疑问，这伙匪徒就是6月16日企图在宁波路130号《晨导报》（The Morning Leader）编辑部发动类似袭击的那群人；当时，正如人们所回忆的那样，警察看守也被缴械，现场开火多枪并投掷了一枚哑弹手榴弹。此外，似乎可以确定，这伙匪徒在周六使用的手榴弹与7月16日上午在南京路发现的两枚属于同一批次，这些手榴弹很可能是恐怖分子在最后时刻因觉得投掷过于危险而丢弃的。与此同时，大量嫌疑人已受到仔细讯问，虽然负责此案的警务官员昨日拒绝透露有关枪战的任何信息，但据悉目前仅有四名嫌疑人仍被拘留，他们大多有前科，且均为江浦（Kompo，音译）籍人，该地区以枪手和其他罪犯闻名。

英勇事迹

然而，周六的事件不仅引起了轰动，也是这座城市中罕见的一次英勇表现。

A. F. “塔格”·威尔逊（A. F. "Tug" Wilson）先生于周六晚9点30分因心脏部位遭受枪伤去世。事发时，他正在位于枪战现场街对面的自家店铺内招待顾客。他冲向门口，试图穿过街道去协助警察，但被一位朋友拦住，劝他躲在掩体下，不要冒被枪击的风险。然而，威尔逊挣脱了朋友的紧紧抓握，冲向弄堂。当他快要到达那里时，向他方向射出了15发子弹。身受致命伤的威尔逊鼓起最后一点力气，试图冲回自己的店铺，却倒在马路中央。随后，一名法国士兵爬向这名伤者，冒着极大的个人风险将他拖到街道的法方一侧，之后他被救护车紧急送往医院。

当时在场的一名华籍侦探在自己已经中弹并躺在排水沟里的情况下，继续向逃跑的枪手射击，他甚至有可能被警方误伤。然而，他用一根手指扣住扳机，另一只手展示他的侦探徽章，一直射击直到罪犯消失，随后他被紧急送往医院。

当时就在附近的W. H. 威多森（W. H. Widdowson）巡官也冒着生命危险冲进弄堂，逮捕了一名目前在押的嫌疑人，尽管后者一手拿着手榴弹，另一手拿着毛瑟手枪。

在随后的汉口路枪战中，见习警长

pages.en:
Zborovsky, who headed the search
party responsible for the apprehen-
sion of two additional suspects and
who has only been with the S.M.P.
for eight months, courageously faced
being shot at point-blank range and
fire only after he had ascertained
that he was not endangering any of
the many pedestrians on the
thoroughfare at the time.

The Chinese constable who was
robbed of his pistol as the gang
emerged from inside the alley
and who, on giving chase, although
greatly out-numbered, was shot and
dragged to the ground with injuries to
his right knee, also deserves special
mention.

Reserve Unit Busy

Whilst detectives were busy in
their offices, the Reserve Unit of the
S.M.P. was on continuous duty from
8.30 p.m. on Saturday until 8 a.m.
yesterday as they continued to search
hotels, lodging houses and the scene
of the shootings in an endeavour to
find additional arms and ammunition.

The condition of the injured per-
sons remains unchanged, with three
in a very serious condition and others
only slightly injured although need-
ing hospital attention. Miss Nelly
Schikinskaya, 19 year-old dance
partner employed by the Palais Cafe,
was reported to be doing well yester-
day, having been admitted to the
Russian Orthodox Hospital, Route
Say Zoong, with a gunshot injury to
her knee, sustained when she alighted
from a bus at the corner of Kiangse
Road and Avenue Edward VII.

Meanwhile, high police officials
were in conference yesterday morn-
ing studying drastic precautionary
measures which are to be taken in
attempting to prevent similar incid-
ents, whilst four suspects will face
the First Special District Court this
morning when the police will ask
for their remand in custody.

Judge N. E. Lurton, and Mr. Gordon
Campbell, Coroner and Marshal res-
pectively, of the United States Court
for China, viewed the body of Mr.
Wilson yesterday morning and per-
mitted its removal to the Internation-
al Funeral Directors. The inquest
will open at 10.30 a.m. tomorrow.

Full details regarding the method
employed by the gangsters in obtain-
ing the four cars were also gathered
yesterday. It appears that one of
the men presented himself at the
Ford Hire Service Station on Edin-
burgh Road shortly before .8 p.m.
and ordered four cars. He seated
himself in the first and the others
followed to the Ts Yu Pang alley
where, as already reported in the
"North-China Daily News" on July 7,
some 150 well-armed desperadoes
have their headquarters, it being here
too that a police search-party was
fired at on July 2. About 20 men
entered the cars and ordered the
drivers to take them to Kiangse Road,
when the shoot-up started.

Although no confirmation could be
obtained, it seems certain that the
gang acted on instructions from a
pro-Wang Ching-wei organization and
it was held likely yesterday that firm
representations would be made to the
"Ta Tao" authorities by the S.M.P.
regarding the free access which
armed criminals have to the Settle-
ment from Edinburgh and other out-
lying roads.

An inquest on the two Chinese
killed in the affair, will be opened
this morning, whilst the condition
of the injured suspect was understood
to be satisfactory enough to permit
questioning by investigating detec-
tives.
pages.zh:
兹博罗夫斯基（Zborovsky，音译）率领搜捕队抓获了另外两名嫌疑人，他加入上海公共租界工部局警务处仅八个月，在确认不会危及当时大道上的众多行人后，勇敢地面对近距离的枪口并开火。

当匪徒从弄堂里出来时，一名华籍巡捕的手枪被抢走，他在追击过程中，尽管寡不敌众，仍被击中并拖倒在地，右膝受伤，这也值得特别提及。

后备队忙碌

当侦探们在办公室忙碌时，上海公共租界工部局警务处的后备队从周六晚8点30分到昨天上午8点连续执勤，继续搜查旅馆、客栈以及枪战现场，试图寻找更多的武器和弹药。

伤者的状况保持不变，其中三人情况非常危急，其他人伤势较轻但仍需住院治疗。据报道，19岁的帕莱咖啡馆（Palais Cafe）舞女内莉·希金斯卡娅（Nelly Schikinskaya，音译）女士昨日情况良好，她因在江西路与爱德华七世大道拐角处下车时膝盖中弹，被送入霞飞路（Route Say Zoong）的东正教医院。

与此同时，警方高层昨日上午召开会议，研究旨在防止类似事件发生的严厉预防措施，而四名嫌疑人将于今天上午在第一特区法院出庭，警方将申请将其还押候审。

美国驻华法院的法官N. E. 勒顿（N. E. Lurton，音译）先生，以及验尸官兼法警戈登·坎贝尔（Gordon Campbell）先生，昨日上午查验了威尔逊先生的遗体，并允许将其移交给国际殡仪馆。死因审讯将于明天上午10点30分开始。

关于匪徒如何获取这四辆汽车的详细情况也于昨日查明。据悉，其中一人在晚上8点前不久出现在爱丁堡路的福特租车服务站，订购了四辆汽车。他坐进第一辆车，其余车辆跟随至慈裕邦弄（Ts Yu Pang alley，音译），正如7月7日《字林西报》所报道，约有150名武装亡命之徒在此设有总部，也是在这里，警方搜捕队曾于7月2日遭到射击。大约20人进入车内，命令司机将他们带到江西路，随即枪战爆发。

虽然无法获得证实，但似乎可以肯定，这伙匪徒是受亲汪精卫组织的指使行动，昨日认为，上海公共租界工部局警务处将就武装罪犯从爱丁堡路及其他外围道路自由进入租界一事，向“大陶”（Ta Tao，音译）当局提出严正交涉。

关于在此事件中遇害的两名中国人的死因审讯将于今天上午开始，而据悉受伤嫌疑人的状况足以接受调查侦探的讯问。

pages.en:
CHINA PRESS

American, Chinese Die
As Thugs, Police Stage
Furious Armed Clash

Polish Girl Seriously
Injured; 3 Chinese
Policemen Hurt

ANOTHER SHOOTUP
4 MINUTES LATER

Terrorists Open Fire
In Printing Plant Of
Chinese Papers

By CARROLL ALCOTT
Terrorism broke out again
in Shanghai last night and
when the smoke of two ter-
rific gun battles and three or
four bombings had cleared
away, one American and one
Chinese were dead, one Polish
girl was wounded, while 16
Chinese including three Chin-
ese Police Constables of the
Shanghai Municipal Police
were suffering from bullet
wounds to varying degrees of
seriousness.
The dead American is Captain
A. F. "Tug" Wilson, proprietor
of the New Ritz Bar and Res-
taurant.
The Chinese were pedestrians
whose names had not yet been
determined at a late hour last
night.
The wounded Polish girl is
said to be a taxi-dancer em-
ployed in a Rue Chu Pao San
cabaret. She was wounded
about the legs and arms.
Despite the fact that her con-
dition is serious, it is believed
that she will live.
In addition to the three Chinese
police constables, the wounded in-
clude Chinese printers, pedestrians,
peanut vendors and gangsters. One
of the gunmen involved in the
shootings is seriously wounded while
one of his companions is in the
hands of the police.
The wounds of some of the vic-
tims are said to be serious and
they are not expected to live.

（手写批注：23/7）
pages.zh:
《大陆报》（CHINA PRESS）

美籍与华籍人士身亡
暴徒与警方爆发激烈武装冲突

波兰女孩重伤；三名
华籍巡捕受伤

四分钟后再次发生枪战

恐怖分子在华文报纸
印刷厂开火

作者：卡罗尔·奥尔科特（CARROLL ALCOTT）

昨晚恐怖主义再次在上海爆发，当两场激烈的枪战和三四起爆炸的硝烟散去后，一名美国人和一名中国人死亡，一名波兰女孩受伤，另有16名中国人（包括三名上海公共租界工部局华籍巡捕）遭受不同程度的枪伤。

死者中的美国人是新丽都酒吧餐厅（New Ritz Bar and Restaurant）的老板A. F. “塔格”·威尔逊上尉。

死者中的中国人是行人，截至昨晚深夜，其姓名尚未确定。

受伤的波兰女孩据称是朱葆三路（Rue Chu Pao San）一家歌舞厅的伴舞女郎。她的腿部和手臂受伤。

尽管她的伤势严重，但相信她能存活。

除了三名华籍巡捕外，伤者还包括华籍印刷工人、行人、花生小贩和匪徒。参与枪战的一名枪手身受重伤，而他的一名同伙已被警方控制。

据说部分受害者的伤势严重，预计难以存活。

（手写批注：23/7）

pages.en:
Started In Badlands

The story of these outrages sounds like a shipwrecked sailor's nightmare. It started at a Ford Hire Station on Edinburgh Road. It was here that more than 15 armed gunmen from the "badlands" engaged four hire cars and started out on one of the wildest rides that has ever been recorded in the city's history.

These 15 men were cold, hard killers. They were under orders from a group of plotters to attack pro-Chinese newspapers inside the International Settlement, according to information obtained by the police last night.

Just what happened after the gunmen left the Ford Hire Station and the time they reached the scene of their first attacks on Avenue Edward VII, Shanghai's newspaper row, is a trifle obscure. But it is known that they stopped en route to pick up cargoes of hand-grenades. This has been substantiated by the fact that eight hand-grenades were seized by the police or found near the scene of some of the outrages.

The first stop of the terrorist mob was the corner of Kiangse Road and Avenue Edward VII.

Invade Newspaper Plants

At this point, the gunmen ordered the chauffeurs of their cars to stop and park at the side of the street near a railless tram station. One gangster, as near as could be learned last night, remained in each car to guard the chauffeurs. The remaining mobsters left the machines, walked down Avenue Edward VII to an alleyway leading to the old Shanghai Cotton Exchange Building, now occupied by the printing plants of a number of newspapers.

Six of the gunmen, brandishing their Mausers, entered the building and walked up the stairs to the typesetting rooms of the Ta Wan Pao, British registered Chinese language daily.

A telegraph messenger boy was standing on the landing as the gunmen put in their appearance. The youth commenced to scream, pleaded with the terrorists not to shoot him.

"I'm only a messenger boy," he whimpered.

One of the gunmen fired a shot at the boy's feet and told him to stand quiet in a corner of the landing. "Then you won't get hurt," said the terrorist.

Watchman Acts

The shot attracted the attention of a watchman employed by the Chinese-American Daily News, which occupies the premises of the second floor. Noticing that the terrorists were coming on up the stairs, he shut and bolted a wooden door at the top of the landing. Thus blocked, the gangsters retraced their steps and returned to the rooms of the Ta Wan Pao, where they upset a few trays of type but engaged in no serious shooting.
pages.zh:
始于“歹地”

这些暴行的经过听起来就像遇难水手的噩梦。故事始于爱丁堡路的一家福特租车行。正是在这里，来自“歹地”的15多名武装枪手租用了四辆租赁汽车，开始了这座城市历史上记录到的最疯狂的兜风之一。

据警方昨晚获得的情报，这15人是冷酷无情的杀手。他们受一群阴谋策划者的命令，攻击国际租界内的亲华报纸。

枪手离开福特租车行到抵达他们在爱德华七世大道（上海报业街）首次发动袭击的现场之间究竟发生了什么，以及具体时间，尚有些模糊。但已知他们在途中停下以装载手榴弹。警方缴获或在一些暴行现场附近发现了八枚手榴弹，这一事实证实了这一点。

恐怖团伙的第一站是江西路与爱德华七世大道的拐角处。

入侵报社厂房

在此处，枪手命令他们的司机停车并停在靠近一个无轨电车站的路边。据昨晚了解，每辆车里留有一名匪徒看守司机。其余的暴徒离开车辆，沿着爱德华七世大道走到一条通往旧上海棉花交易所大楼的弄堂，该大楼现在被多家报纸的印刷厂占用。

六名枪手挥舞着毛瑟手枪进入大楼，走上楼梯，来到英商注册的中文日报《大晚报》（Ta Wan Pao）的排字间。

当枪手出现时，一名电报信童正站在楼梯平台上。这名年轻人开始尖叫，恳求恐怖分子不要开枪打他。

“我只是个信童，”他呜咽道。

一名枪手朝男孩的脚边开了一枪，让他安静地站在平台的一个角落里。“这样你就不会受伤，”恐怖分子说。

看守采取行动

枪声引起了占据二楼 premises 的《中美日报》（Chinese-American Daily News）一名看守的注意。注意到恐怖分子正沿楼梯上来，他关上并闩住了平台顶部的一扇木门。受阻后，匪徒们原路返回，回到《大晚报》的房间，在那里他们打翻了几盘铅字，但没有进行严重的射击。

pages.en:
Printers Wounded

Leaving these rooms, the mobsters returned to the ground floor where they were joined by the rest of the gang. They attempted to enter the press rooms of both the Chinese-American Daily News and the Ta Wan Pao, which is located on the ground floor of the building. There they opened fire on a group of defenseless printers.

The first volley wounded Wang Shih-ven, 40, native of Ningpo, and Koo Shing-chou, 35, native of Soochow, both printers. Wang was seriously wounded and his condition, up to a late hour last night, was critical.

The terrorists then started for the entrance of the alley, shooting as they ran. One bullet struck a Chinese coolie who happened to be caught in the line of fire. He died a few minutes later.

It was at this juncture that Captain Wilson, hearing the shooting, dashed across the street from the New Ritz and attempted to intervene. The terrorists turned their guns in his direction. The captain fell to the pavement, fatally wounded.

After leaving the alley, the terrorists started a mad dash for their parked automobiles on Kiangse Road near the corner of Avenue Edward VII. By this time, both the French and Settlement police had commenced to gather.

Gun Battle Follows

The shooting that followed was one of the most violent in the crime history of Shanghai. More than 120 shots were exchanged while the bandits threw one hand grenade in front of the building occupied by THE CHINA PRESS and the Shanghai Times. Three Chinese police constables were wounded during this phase of the incident. It was also at this juncture that the Polish girl, who was just leaving a bus at the corner of Kiangse Road and Avenue Edward VII sustained bullet wounds to the legs and arms.

Because of the large crowd of pedestrians on the street at the time, the police found it necessary to exercise considerable care in their shooting with the result that the terrorists all reached their automobiles and departed from the vicinity. They continued to shoot from the windows of the cars, however, as the machines disappeared from sight.

While the terrorists managed to vanish from the neighborhood, they turned up again in a matter of a few minutes. The cars separated in driving through side streets of the Central and Louza Districts but the terrorists, their killing instincts not yet satisfied, continued to create more disorder.

Car Searched

At 8.40 p.m., Sergeant Zbrovsky, of the Louza Police Station, heading a patrol of three Chinese Police constables, was on duty at the corner of Chekiang and Hankow Roads. One of the gangster cars was speeding along Hankow Road in an easterly direction. Zbrovsky, who had been searching cars all evening, stepped in front of the machine and raised his hand in a motion to the chauffeur to stop.
pages.zh:
印刷工人受伤

暴徒离开这些房间后，回到一楼，与其他同伙会合。他们试图进入位于该楼底层的《中美日报》（Chinese-American Daily News）和《大晚报》（Ta Wan Pao）的印刷车间。在那里，他们向一群毫无防备的印刷工人开火。

第一排子弹击伤了王世文（Wang Shih-ven，音译），40岁，宁波人，以及顾星洲（Koo Shing-chou，音译），35岁，苏州人，两人均为印刷工人。王某伤势严重，直至昨晚深夜，其情况仍属危急。

随后，恐怖分子一边奔跑一边向巷口方向射击。一颗子弹击中了一名恰好处于火力线上的中国苦力。几分钟后，该苦力死亡。

就在此时，威尔逊上尉（Captain Wilson）听到枪声，从新丽都大戏院（New Ritz）冲过街道，试图进行干预。恐怖分子将枪口转向他的方向。上尉倒在人行道上，受致命伤。

离开巷子后，恐怖分子疯狂逃窜，奔向停在靠近爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）拐角处的江西路（Kiangse Road）上的汽车。此时，法租界巡捕和公共租界巡捕均已开始集结。

随之发生枪战

随后的枪战是上海犯罪史上最激烈的枪战之一。双方交火超过120发，匪徒在《字林西报》（THE CHINA PRESS）和《上海泰晤士报》（Shanghai Times）所占据的大楼前投掷了一枚手榴弹。在此阶段的事件中，三名华捕警员受伤。也正是在此时，一名波兰籍少女在江西路与爱多亚路拐角处刚下一辆公交车时，腿部和手臂中弹受伤。

由于当时街上行人众多，警方发现必须极其谨慎地开枪，结果所有恐怖分子都得以登上汽车并离开该地区。然而，当车辆驶离视线时，他们继续从车窗向外射击。

虽然恐怖分子一度从附近消失，但几分钟后再次出现。车辆在穿过中区（Central）和老闸区（Louza）的小街时分散行驶，但恐怖分子的杀戮本能尚未得到满足，继续制造更多混乱。

搜查汽车

晚上8点40分，老闸捕房的兹布罗夫斯基警长（Sergeant Zbrovsky）率领三名华捕警员组成的巡逻队，在浙江路与汉口路的拐角处执勤。一辆匪徒的汽车正沿汉口路向东疾驰。兹布罗夫斯基整晚一直在搜查车辆，他走到车前，举手示意司机停车。

pages.en:
Two terrorists were in the car
and they immediately opened fire
on the sergeant. A bullet whistled
past his head and the officer
ducked just in time to miss con-
tacting a second messenger of death.
It was at this identical moment
that the three Chinese constables
went into action and open fire on
the car.
The first volley from the police
guns wounded one of the ter-
rorists. Subsequent volleys rid-
dled the car with bullets. The
wounded gangster slumped for-
ward in the seat while his mate
attempted to jump from the
machine and escape. He was
caught, however, and relieved of
his Mauser. In this car, the
police found five hand grenades.
The haul also netted them the
two military Mausers which the
terrorists were carrying.
Newspaper Office Bombed
At almost the same moment, an-
other of the terrorist cars drove up
to a small Chinese language news-
paper on Kwangsi Road near Sze-
xiang Road. Its gunmen pitched
two hand grenades at the front
entrance of the establishment and
then attempted to make off.
It so happened that a police patrol
party from the Louza Station was
near this spot and immediately
opened fire on the gangsters. The
terrorists fled from the machine
and disappeared down side street.
Seven persons, including bystanders
and printers, were wounded during
the bombing.
It is believed that some of the
gangsters were wounded but this
could not be confirmed up to an early
hour this morning. A large num-
ber of suspects are reported to have
been taken into custody, however,
and were being held at the Louza
Station last night for questioning.
Another of the four cars was
found on Rue du Consulat in the
French Concession. The machine
had been abandoned. Three hand-
grenades were found near this
machine.
The fourth car also was account-
ed for last night. The gangsters
deserted the machine in the
Bubbling Well Road district and
the chauffeur drove back to the
Edinburgh Station to report the
affair. The police were notified
and the chauffeur is now being
held for interrogation.
Several Theories
Several theories as to the motive
back of last night's shootings and
bombings have been advanced by
the police. One is that was solely
an attack on pro-Chinese news-
papers. Another is that the
shootings were carried out both
with the idea of terrorizing Chin-
ese language dailies and at the
same time obtaining revenge for
the shooting by S.M.P. officers of
two "Ta Tao" police officers on
Stone Bridge three days ago.
A number of automobiles parked
along Avenue Edward VII were
riddled with bullets during the
shooting in that area. One of
these was owned by Mr. A. Morley,
editor of the Shanghai Times.
Another machine which received
similar treatment is owned by Mr.
Laci, Avenue Edward VII restaurant
owner. A French police officer,
standing behind a concrete power
post, became a trifle excited and
instead of shooting at the gang-
sters, fired six shots into Mr. Laci's
car.
As a result of last night's out-
rages, Shanghai was turned into
an armed camp before 9 p.m. Police
patrols in most sections of the
Settlement and the French Conces-
sion, were doubled and in some
cases, even trebled. Alleys, hotels
and even private Chinese dwellings
were subjected to thorough searches
while all automobiles were stopped
and searched.
pages.zh:
车内有两名恐怖分子，
他们立即向警长开火。
一颗子弹呼啸着擦过他的头部，
警官及时蹲下，躲过了
第二颗致命的子弹。
就在同一时刻，
三名华捕警员投入行动，
向汽车开火。
警方的第一轮齐射
击伤了一名恐怖分子。
随后的几轮射击
将汽车打得千疮百孔。
受伤的匪徒向前瘫倒在座位上，
而他的同伙则试图跳车逃跑。
然而，他被抓获，
并被缴获了毛瑟手枪。
在这辆车里，
警方发现了五枚手榴弹。
此次行动还缴获了
恐怖分子携带的两支军用毛瑟手枪。
报社遭炸弹袭击
几乎在同一时刻，
另一辆恐怖分子的汽车驶至
靠近四川路（Sze-xiang Road）的广西路（Kwangsi Road）上的一家小型中文报社。
其枪手向该机构的前门投掷了两枚手榴弹，
然后试图逃离。
碰巧老闸捕房的一支巡逻队
就在附近，并立即向匪徒开火。
恐怖分子弃车而逃，
消失在一条小街中。
包括旁观者和印刷工人在内的
七人在爆炸中受伤。
据信部分匪徒受伤，
但直到今天凌晨早些时候
尚无法证实这一点。
据报道，大量嫌疑人已被拘留，
昨晚被关押在老闸捕房
接受讯问。
四辆汽车中的另一辆
在法租界的领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）被发现。
该车已被遗弃。
在该车附近发现了三枚手榴弹。
第四辆车昨晚也已找到下落。
匪徒在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）地区
弃车而去，
司机驾车返回爱丁堡捕房（Edinburgh Station）报告此事。
警方已接到通知，
司机目前正被扣留
接受审讯。
多种推测
警方对昨晚枪击和爆炸案背后的动机
提出了几种推测。一种认为这纯粹是对
亲华报纸的袭击。另一种认为，
枪击案的实施既是为了恐吓
中文日报，同时也是为了报复
三天前工部局警务处（S.M.P.）警员
在外白渡桥（Stone Bridge）枪击
两名“大道”警察一事。
在该地区枪战期间，
停放在爱多亚路沿线的
多辆汽车被子弹打得千疮百孔。
其中一辆属于《上海泰晤士报》编辑
莫利先生（Mr. A. Morley）。
另一辆遭受同样待遇的汽车
属于爱多亚路餐馆老板
拉奇先生（Mr. Laci）。
一名法国警官
站在混凝土电线杆后，
变得有些激动，
他没有向匪徒射击，
而是向拉奇先生的汽车
开了六枪。
由于昨晚的暴行，
上海在晚上9点前变成了
一个武装营地。
租界大部分地区和法租界的
警察巡逻队增加了一倍，
在某些情况下甚至增加了两倍。
小巷、旅馆
甚至私人住宅都受到了
彻底搜查，
所有汽车均被拦停并接受检查。

Suspect released
The 6th suspect (Tai Tse Jing) was discharged from
the Police Hospital on August 14 and appeared before the
Court on August 16 when his release was requested.
This man is one of the victims wounded during the Louga
shooting affray. Investigations have proven that he was
in no way connected with the terrorists and that he
happened to be in the vicinity at the time the shooting
took place.

Letter received
by "Chinese-American
Daily News".
Below is a rough translation of a letter received
at the offices of the "Chinese-American Daily News" on
August 18:-

"It has been learned that the puppet
"Wang Ching Wei" has engaged "Ting
Meu Tsung" his running dog to
instruct "Lee Sze Chuen" the small
running dog to make a disturbance at
your premises at the end of August.
The man "Lee" on receipt of these
instructions handed the matter to
"Sung Yung Kiang", the 3rd Section,
who has been given a sum of $5000.00
for expenses. The latter after having
received the sum of the money brought
32 members of his section to commence
the work. Plans are being discussed
in Room 224, An Loh Kong Restaurant
(Hotel) and Room 308 of the "Dah Fong
Hotel". They decided to approach the
employees of your newspaper office by
bribery to obtain a certificate of
admission. They could enter your
premises by forging the certificate.
Attention should be given by your
staff regarding people visiting your
office by the main entrance.
On receipt of this letter please do
not say anything and I will let you
know if there is any further news.
People of China.
17-8-39 night."

嫌疑人获释
第6号嫌疑人（戴子敬 Tai Tse Jing，音译）于8月14日从警察医院出院，并于8月16日出庭，当时申请将其释放。此人是老闸枪战事件中受伤的受害者之一。调查已证明他与恐怖分子没有任何关联，枪击发生时他恰好在附近。

《中美日报》
收到信件。
以下是8月18日在《中美日报》办公室收到的一封信的粗略译文：——

“获悉傀儡
‘汪精卫’已指派其走狗‘丁默邨’
指示小走狗‘李士群’
于八月底在贵处制造事端。
‘李’接到指示后，将此事宜交给
第三科的‘宋勇江’（Sung Yung Kiang，音译），
并已给予其5000.00美元作为经费。
后者收到这笔钱后，
带领其科室的32名成员开始行动。
他们正在安乐宫酒楼（An Loh Kong Restaurant (Hotel)）的224室
和‘大华饭店’（Dah Fong Hotel）的308室
商讨计划。他们决定通过贿赂
贵报馆员工以获取入场证。
他们可以伪造证件进入贵处。
贵方员工应注意
经由正门来访的人员。
收到此信后请勿声张，
如有进一步消息，我会通知你们。
中国人。
39年8月17日晚。”

The writ of detention granted by the court to enable enquiries to be made regarding the seven suspects now being held in connection with this case will expire on August 7.

Enquiries have not definitely ascertained beyond all doubt that the 3rd suspect (Woo Yih Wu) 3rd (Ling Hung Jung) and 7th (Yih Yoong Kai) are in no way connected with those concerned in the bombing and shooting affray. Their release will be requested.

The 4th (Chu Tei Ling), 5th (Chang S Tsung) and 6th (Tai Ta Ching) suspects are still detained in Hospital. Their condition is considerably improved, but it is not anticipated that they will be discharged for at least two more weeks.

A further remand of two weeks will be requested.

Yih Yoong Kai.
Foochow.                                C.D.C. 175.
Central Stn.        3-8-39.

    Yih Yoong Kai, age 30, Foochow, S/unemployed, residing
41 Dong Shing Lee, Zau Tseu Road, Nantao.
    At 8 a.m. on the 2/7/39 I proceeded to the 2nd Refugee
Camp on Route Sieyes F.C. with intent to borrow some money
from a friend named Wong Zee Kwei who is a supervisor in
the Refugee Camp. I did not meet him, however I encountered
a fellow-countryman named Sai Dee who informed me that Wong
Zee Kwei has left there to do some work elsewhere. I then
proceeded to the Sen Shing Kwei (food shop), 222 Rue Lafayette
near Rue Walkwe where I borrowed 20 cents from a friend named
Ning Sien Nung, it was then about 5 p.m. I then again
proceeded to the Bund at No.5 and No.6 Pontoons where a friend
of mine named Zung Foh used to ply his sampan. Instead of
seeing Zung Foh I met an ex-fellow-workman one named Ah Pau,
native of Kiangying, who is now working as a sampanman. He
told me that Zung Foh had left for Yangtsepoo. I then
partook of supper with Ah Pau and got 20 cents from him.
After which, I intended to go and make some enquiries at a
hospital situated at the opposite of the Great World with a
view to getting rid of my opium habit. When I walked to a
place on Ave Edw. VII west of Kiangse Road I heard a shooting
taking place at a distance of about 60 yards east of Kiangse
Road. I then saw pedestrians crying and running about and at
the same time saw a C.P.C. taking out his pistol and ordering
the pedestrians to run away. He then went towards Kiangse
Road to conceal himself, so I followed behind him with my
hands embracing my head. When nearing Kiangse Road I was

叶永凯（Yih Yoong Kai）。
福州。                                C.D.C. 175.
中央捕房        39年8月3日。

    叶永凯，30岁，福州人，失业，居住于南市兆丰路（Zau Tseu Road，音译）东兴里41号。
    39年7月2日上午8时，我前往法租界赛义斯路（Route Sieyes）的第二难民收容所，意图向一位名叫黄子贵（Wong Zee Kwei，音译）的朋友借钱，他是该收容所的监工。但我未见到他，却遇到了一位名叫赛迪（Sai Dee，音译）的同乡，他告知我黄子贵已离开那里去别处工作。随后，我前往拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）靠近华尔克路（Rue Walkwe，音译）的222号森兴桂食品店（Sen Shing Kwei），从一位名叫宁先农（Ning Sien Nung，音译）的朋友那里借了20分钱，当时大约是下午5点。接着，我又前往外滩5号和6号浮码头，我的朋友钟福（Zung Foh，音译）曾在那里划舢板。我没见到钟福，却遇到了一位以前的同事，名叫阿保（Ah Pau，音译），江阴人，现在也是舢板夫。他告诉我钟福已去了杨树浦。随后我与阿保共进晚餐，并从他那里得到了20分钱。之后，我打算去大世界对面的一家医院咨询，以期戒除鸦片烟瘾。当我走到爱多亚路上江西路以西的一处地方时，我听到约60码外的江西路以东发生了枪击。我看到行人哭喊着四处奔逃，同时看到一名华捕警员掏出枪，命令行人跑开。随后他朝江西路方向跑去躲避，所以我双手抱头跟在他后面。当接近江西路时，我

pages.en:

struck by a stray bullet on my cheek which penetrated into
my left arm. I then immediately returned back to Avenue
Edward VII and hid myself in a garage. A short while later
I was conveyed by ambulance to the Lester Chinese Hospital
and later transferred to the Police Hospital. On the
3/8/39 i left the hospital and was brought to the station.

Sgd. Yih Yoong Kai.

Ting Yung Sung
Chinkiang                                      xx C.D. . . . U
Central Stn.           29-7-39

Ting Yung Sung, age 39, Chinkiang, H.Y.A.
In the middle of April this year I came to Shanghai from
Chinkiang. The last few months I used to sleep in the Doong
Hoong Lodging House, situated at Rue du Saigon, French
Concession.
On the 21-7-39 as I had no money so I slept on the
footpath near the S.M.C. Public School, Pakhoi Road.
At about 7pm. on 22-7-39 I was walking on Hankow Road near
the Ya Chow Lodging House begging for money from pedestrians.
At about 8pm. when approaching the Lao Lih Tsai Restaurant I
suddenly heard the sound of shooting coming from behind. When
I felt something hit my head I found my head was bleeding. At
that time I saw a number of people running towards the Tsing
Zien Bath House and I followed them into the alleyway nearby.
I did not know what was the matter. Shortly afterwards
I was conveyed to the Police Hospital by an ambulance with others
This is my true statement.
RL
Signed: Ting Yung Sung.
pages.zh:
丁荣松（音译）
镇江                                      xx C.D ____  U
中央捕房           1939年7月29日

丁荣松（音译），39岁，镇江人，H.Y.A.（注：缩写含义不明）。
今年四月中旬我从镇江来到上海。最近几个月，我一直住在法租界西贡路（Rue du Saigon）的东宏旅馆（Doong Hoong Lodging House，音译）。
1939年7月21日，因身无分文，我睡在公共租界工部局公立学校附近的柏高路（Pakhoi Road，即今黄陂北路）人行道上。
1939年7月22日晚7时许，我在汉口路亚周旅馆（Ya Chow Lodging House，音译）附近向行人乞讨。
晚8时许，当我走近老利才餐馆（Lao Lih Tsai Restaurant，音译）时，突然听到身后传来枪声。当感到有东西击中我的头部时，我发现头部正在流血。当时我看到许多人跑向清鉴浴室（Tsing Zien Bath House，音译），我也跟随他们进入附近的小巷。
我不知道发生了什么事。不久后，我和其他人一起被救护车送往警察医院。
以上是我的真实陈述。
RL
签名：丁荣松（Ting Yung Sung）。

pages.en:
Woo Yih Wei
Kwantung // C.C.C. 140
Control

Woo Yih Wei, aged 29 years, S/Broker, Kwantung, residing
at No. 703 Sing Kong Lee, Kiukiang Road.
On December 18th, 1938, I was convicted in the Court
on a charge of "Receiving Stolen Property" and subsequently
sentenced to six months imprisonment. Since my release from
the gaol on June 18th, this year, I have been living and working
with a fortune teller named Dah Kwei Dai at the Shing Hwa
chili dressing shop, No. 12, Sz Woo Lee (Tel. No. 97760) because
the owner of the shop named Woo Tsoh Chung is an intimate
friend of mine. I daily take my meal in the Shing Kee
Food Shop, the proprietor being one named Lee, a native of
Canton. Sometimes I took meal in the shop without paying
cash if I had no money on person and the account would be
entered to my credit.
At 8.10 p.m. on July 22nd, this year I proceeded to the
above restaurant to partake of food and after finishing my
meal at about 8.30 p.m. I intended to leave the shop and
visit a friend of mine named Koh Hwa Kwung, an inspector in
the employ of the Wing On New Building, Chekiang Rd. I then
left the shop and when I was walking outside the entrance of
the Dah Woo Dai Theatre I was arrested by a Chinese constable
who brought me to the station without having the knowledge
regarding the cause of my arrest. The above is my true
statement.

Signed: Woo Yih Wei.
pages.zh:
吴义伟（音译）
广东 // C.C.C. 140
管控

吴义伟（音译），29岁，股票经纪人，广东人，居住于九江路新康里（Sing Kong Lee，音译）703号。
1938年12月18日，我因“收受赃物”罪在法庭被判刑，随后被判处六个月监禁。自今年6月18日获释出狱以来，我一直与一位名叫达贵戴（Dah Kwei Dai，音译）的算命先生一起生活和工作，地点位于泗州里（Sz Woo Lee，音译）12号的兴华辣椒酱店（Shing Hwa chili dressing shop，音译）（电话：97760），因为该店店主吴佐中（Woo Tsoh Chung，音译）是我的密友。我每天在兴记食品店（Shing Kee Food Shop，音译）用餐，店主是一位姓李的广州人。有时如果我身上没钱，我就赊账吃饭，款项记在我的账上。
今年7月22日晚8点10分，我前往上述餐馆用餐，约在晚8点30分吃完饭后，我打算离开店铺去拜访我的朋友柯华光（Koh Hwa Kwung，音译），他是浙江路永安新大楼（Wing On New Building）的一名稽查员。随后我离开店铺，当我走到大华大戏院（Dah Woo Dai Theatre，音译）门口外时，被一名中国巡捕逮捕，并被带到捕房，但我并不知晓被捕原因。以上是我的真实陈述。

签名：吴义伟（Woo Yih Wei）。

August 4th., 1939.

Suspects believed
held by the Italian
Military.

There is every reason to believe that several
of the terrorists who participated in the Avenue
Edward VII bombing and shooting affray are amongst
the thirty-six armed men recently arrested and now
being detained at the Headquarters of the Italian
Defense Force.

We are fully aware as to the identity of those
involved in the Avenue Edward VII affray, and it is
feared that the speedy disposal of these men
(rumoured negotiations by the Japanese Military
for handing over to them) by the Italian Military
Authorities before the Municipal Police have had
an opportunity to check their ante-cedents is
prejudicial to the law and good order of the Settlement

An identification parade and release of
information regarding those in custody would
certainly clear up any doubt regarding these men's
possible connection with the Avenue Edward VII affray.

嫌疑犯据信
由意大利
军方拘押。

有充分理由相信，参与爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII，即今延安东路）爆炸和枪击事件的几名恐怖分子，就在最近被捕并目前被关押在意大利防卫部队总部的三十六名武装人员之中。

我们完全清楚涉及爱多亚路事件的人员身份，令人担忧的是，在工部局警务处有机会核查这些人的前科之前，意大利军事当局就迅速处置这些人（传闻日本军方正在谈判将其引渡给他们），这将损害租界的法律和良好秩序。

如果进行列队辨认并释放关于在押人员的信息，肯定能消除关于这些人可能与爱多亚路事件有关的任何疑虑。

C.P.C.s Challenge
Terrorists.

The testimony f the six Chinese police constable
who took part in this shooting and bombing affray is
interesting and does substantiate the statements made by
the four Ford Hire Service chauffeurs to the effect that
more than twenty gunmen attacked the newspaper premises.
Fully realizing the type of person they were up
against and despite great odds these six Chinese police-
officers brushed aside all thought of personal safety
and challenged the terrorists.
They showed great bravery and their conduct is
certainly commendable.
They did what was expected of them at considerable
risk to their own lives.
In addition to being fired at by the terrorists
several of the C.P.C.s found themselves in the line of
fire of the French Police.
C.P.C. 1895 displayed exceptional bravery and
despite having received a wound in the leg pursued the
terrorists until he collapsed from exhaustion.
A perusal of the statements will show that the
arrival of the terrorists was first observed by C.P.
1895 (plain clothes duty) who was on duty in **〔此处转录不清〕**
Keng Lee.
The terrorists numbering more than twenty proceeded
direct to the Chinese-American Daily News where six
or seven of them surrounded C.P.C. 1472 who was on duty

中国巡捕挑战
恐怖分子。

参与此次枪击和爆炸事件的六名中国巡捕的证词很有趣，确实证实了四名福特出租车司机所作的陈述，即有二十多名枪手袭击了报馆。
这六名中国警官充分意识到他们所面对的是何种类型的人，尽管处于极大劣势，他们抛开了所有对个人安全的顾虑，向恐怖分子发起挑战。
他们表现出极大的勇气，其行为确实值得称赞。
他们冒着巨大的生命危险，做了人们期望他们做的事。
除了遭到恐怖分子的射击外，几名中国巡捕还发现自己处于法国警察的火力线上。
1895号中国巡捕表现出非凡的勇气，尽管腿部受伤，仍追击恐怖分子，直到因精疲力竭而倒下。
查阅供词可知，恐怖分子的到来最先由1895号中国巡捕（便衣执勤）观察到，他当时正在**〔此处转录不清〕**
庚丽（Keng Lee，音译）执勤。

Eugene C. Lohrman Jr. of events witnessed on
Kiangse Road between 8.15p.m. and 8.45p.m. July 22, 1939.

I left the China Press, 160 Avenue Edward VII a few
seconds before 8.15p.m. on the night of the shooting (July 22)
and proceeded to the corner of Kiangse Road down which I
turned toward Nanking Road.
The pedestrian traffic at the corner was very heavy and
slow moving and there was also heavy pedestrian movement on
both sides of Kiangse Road but except for one railless tram
coming from the direction of Nanking Road there was no motor
traffic.
When I had proceeded a few paces along Kiangse Road I
noticed a sedan motor car approaching in my direction from
the right hand side of the railless tram. Its lights were on.
It was approaching at a moderate rate of speed, perhaps
15 m.p.h. when a man dressed in a black European suit jumped
from the opposite sidewalk in the car's pathway and held up
his hand to halt it. The car slowed down and the man ran
after it. It then came to a stop on the left hand side of
the road just before reaching Avenue Edward VII. I in the
mean time except for an occasional backward glance at the
unusual procedure had continued on my way. Before arriving
at the railless tram I saw another sedan come along from
Nanking Road and draw in behind the first.
The first car was black and the second was brown. I
remember this as both of them returned down the street a few
minutes later. I did not have an opportunity to notice the
license plates and both cars seemed of the same make. I
should have said they were large Citroens although the papers
pages.zh:
Eugene C. Lohrman Jr. 关于1939年7月22日晚8点15分至8点45分之间在江西路目睹事件的陈述。

在枪击案发生当晚（7月22日）8点15分前几秒，我离开了位于爱多亚路160号的《大陆报》（China Press），前往江西路口，随后转向南京路方向。
路口的行人交通非常拥挤且移动缓慢，江西路两侧也有大量行人流动，但除了一辆从南京路方向驶来的无轨电车外，没有机动车交通。
当我沿江西路走了几步后，我注意到一辆轿车从无轨电车的右侧向我方向驶来。车灯亮着。它以中等速度接近，大约每小时15英里，这时一名身穿黑色欧式西装的男子从车道对面的人行道上跳出来，举手示意停车。汽车减速，那名男子追着车跑。随后，在即将到达爱多亚路之前，汽车在道路左侧停了下来。与此同时，除了偶尔回头看看这不寻常的举动外，我继续前行。在到达无轨电车之前，我看到另一辆轿车从南京路驶来，停在第一辆车后面。
第一辆车是黑色的，第二辆是棕色的。我记得这一点，因为几分钟后两辆车都沿街道返回。我没有机会注意车牌，两辆车似乎是同一品牌。我应该说它们是大型雪铁龙汽车，尽管报纸

- 2 -

declare they have been identified as Fords.
    hen I had passed the railless tram and had travelled
about two thirds of the block, four or five loud reports rang
out from the direction of venue Edward VII. The streets
were emptied in about half a minutes, most of the people
running into doorways. I returned to investigate not
believing that these could actually be shots. The firing
continued and when I approached a position opposite the now
empty tram I took shelter in a wall niche.
    No bullets came in my general direction and peering out
I could distinguish an occasional running figure at the Ave.
Edward VII intersection. Both cars were parked on the corner
as yet but in a minute or two the one in the rear backed down
the street till it came to the tram and then backed and filled
till it was able to turn its nose down Kiangse Road toward
Nanking Road. It drove off.
    At about this time a Chinese constable walked up the
sidewalk and stationing himself behind a telegraph pole
about five paces above me opened an intermittent fire in the
direction of Ave. Edward VII the while he blew blasts on a
very feeble whistle.
    The black car now backed down the street and when it had
reached the tram it backed around so that it stood at right
angles to the street. It remained in this position for a
few seconds and I do not believe the Chinese constable fired
at it. If he did, no damage was done for the car paid him
no heed but continued in a moment to back and fill and it too
pages.zh:
- 2 -

声称它们已被确认为福特汽车。
    当我经过无轨电车并行驶了大约三分之二街区时，从爱多亚路方向传来了四五声巨响。街道在大约半分钟内空无一人，大多数人跑进门洞。我返回调查，不相信这些真的是枪声。射击仍在继续，当我走到现在空无一人的电车对面的位置时，我躲在一个墙龛里。
    没有子弹朝我所在的一般方向飞来，向外窥视时，我能分辨出爱多亚路路口偶尔有奔跑的身影。两辆车都停在角落，但在一两分钟内，后面那辆车向后倒车直到电车处，然后通过前后挪动调整方向，使车头朝向江西路往南京路的方向。它开走了。
    大约在这个时候，一名中国巡捕走上人行道，站在比我高约五步的一根电线杆后面，向爱多亚路方向进行间歇性射击，同时吹着声音很微弱的哨子。
    那辆黑色汽车现在向后倒车，当它到达电车处时，它倒车转弯，使其与街道成直角。它在这个位置停留了几秒钟，我不相信那名中国巡捕向它开了火。如果他开了火，也没有造成损坏，因为汽车没有理会他，而是过了一会儿继续前后挪动，它也

pages.en:
- 3 -

headed towards Kiangse Road. At this juncture I decided that
prudence was the better part of valor and ducked down the
street a few steps and into a large doorway which was open.
The black car came slowly down the street and stopped
across the way a few feet beyond my position. I believe
there were two men in the front seat.
In perhaps another minute as I was peering out to get
another glimpse of the car, it seemed that the pistol shots
which had been continuing from Ave. Edward VII began to grow
nearer and suddenly seven or eight men dashed into view round
the bus corner firing at random over their shoulders. None
appeared wounded. Just as they climbed into the car one of
them threw something across the street almost outside the
doorway I stood in. There was a terrific explosion and I
made myself very scarce indeed and so did not see whether
they continued straight down Kiangse or turned off.
Immediately after I made my way back towards Ave. Edward
VII and noted that the Chinese constable was apparently not
wounded as he smiled quite cheerfully at me and walked off
toward Nanking Road blowing his whistle. One civilian as
I supposed, was standing on a doorstep with his leg bared to
the thigh and blood pouring from a bullet hole. On the corner
of the Avenue I saw a coolie stretched out on the ground
picked up and put into a taxi.
It might be of interest to add that on this return I
noticed two alley exits on the Bund side of the street with the
gates closed and evidently locked and with a large crowd of
pages.zh:
- 3 -

朝江西路方向驶去。在此关头，我认为谨慎为上策，便顺着街道向下走了几步，躲进一个敞开的大门洞内。那辆黑色轿车沿街道缓缓驶来，停在我位置前方几英尺处的马路对面。我相信前排座位上有两个人。
大约又过了一分钟，当我探头向外想再看一眼那辆车时，似乎从爱多亚路（Ave. Edward VII）持续传来的手枪声越来越近，突然有七八个人从公共汽车拐角处冲入视野，一边回头随意开枪。这些人似乎都没有受伤。就在他们爬进车里时，其中一人向街道对面扔了个东西，落点几乎就在我所站立门洞的外面。随即发生了一声巨大的爆炸，我立刻迅速逃离现场，因此没有看到他们是继续沿江西路直行还是转弯离开。
随后我立即折返爱多亚路方向，注意到那名华捕显然未受伤，因为他愉快地对我微笑，并吹着哨子向南京路走去。据我推测，有一名平民站在门口台阶上，大腿裸露，子弹孔中鲜血直流。在爱多亚路的拐角处，我看见一名苦力倒在地上，随后被人扶起并送进一辆出租车。
补充一点可能感兴趣的情况：在返回途中，我注意到外滩一侧的街道上有两个弄堂出口，大门紧闭且显然已上锁，后面聚集了大量人群，
