pages.en:
Shooting
Central Stn.

C.P.C. 1472 Tsang Yoong Tsong, attached
to Central Station.
xx C.D.C. 175

C.P.C. 1472 Tsang Yoong Tsong attached to Central Station,
age 26, Shantung, married, having served in the S.M.P. for over
2 years, residing Room 404 Police Quarters Central Station.
At 7p.m. on July 28, 1930 I reported for duty at the
Chung Pei Daily News Office, No. 130 Chung Lee Avenue Edward
VII. At about 8.20p.m. even date whilst I was standing outside
No. 13C a gang consisting of more than 20 culprits, some of whom
were wearing foreign style suits, some black Cantonese silk
jackets and pants and some short jackets of various colours,
suddenly approached. Owing to the shortage of light in the
alleyway I could not recognise them clearly. 6 or 7 persons
then surrounded me while the others all rushed into the office.
One of the men wearing black Cantonese silk jacket and pants
then cut my pistol lanyard with a knife and took away my pistol.
Being over-powered I could not resist at the time. At this
juncture Plain clothes C.P.C. 1895 opened fire at the culprits
who also returned several shots one of which struck on my right
leg and I fell down to the ground. When they all entered the
premises I moved a little towards the right side of the premises.
They remained on the premises for about 10 minutes, then decamped
through the lane in an unknown direction. Later I walked to the
entrance of the lane where I encountered two other C.P.C.s who
took me into the station van which conveyed me to the Lester
Chinese Hospital, where I handed my leather belt and baton to
a Chinese detective. I was later transferred to the Police
Hospital for treatment.
Rk
Sgd: Tsang Yoong Tsong, C.P.C.
1472.
pages.zh:
枪击案
中央巡捕房

华捕编号1472 曾永宗 (Tsang Yoong Tsong)，隶属中央巡捕房。
xx 西捕编号175

华捕编号1472 曾永宗 (Tsang Yoong Tsong)，隶属中央巡捕房，年龄26岁，山东人，已婚，在工部局警务处服役超过2年，居住于中央巡捕房警察宿舍404室。
1930年7月28日晚7时，我在爱多亚路忠利大楼130号《中报》(Chung Pei Daily News) 办公室报到执勤。当晚约8时20分，当我站在13C号门外时，一伙由二十多名罪犯组成的团伙突然逼近，其中一些人穿着西式服装，一些人穿着黑色广东丝绸衣裤，还有一些人穿着各种颜色的短夹克。由于弄堂内光线不足，我无法清晰辨认他们。随后有六七人将我包围，其余人则全部冲进办公室。其中一名身穿黑色广东丝绸衣裤的男子用刀割断了我的手枪挂绳，抢走了我的手枪。因寡不敌众，我当时无法抵抗。就在此时，便衣华捕编号1895向罪犯开火，罪犯也还击数枪，其中一枪击中我的右腿，我倒在地上。当他们全部进入室内后，我向右侧移动了一点。他们在室内停留了约10分钟，然后通过弄堂向不明方向逃窜。后来我走到弄堂口，遇到了另外两名华捕，他们把我送上警车，将我送往莱斯特尔华人医院 (Lester Chinese Hospital)，在那里我将皮带和警棍交给了一名华探。随后我被转送至警察医院接受治疗。
Rk
签名：华捕 曾永宗 (Tsang Yoong Tsong)，编号1472。

pages.en:
Case No. 919
Fleming. . . . Jones
Inspector . . . . 27/7/30 . . . . 208

I was on duty outside the Shanghai Times Building 16C
Av.Ed.VII. At about 8.10 p.m. when I suddenly heard shooting
inside the Lang Aung Li alleyway at the side of the building.
I drew my pistol and peered round the corner of the lane and
saw about 10 persons running towards the entrance of the lane
firing pistols as they ran. I fired 2 shots into the lane and
then dashed back and took cover in the doorway of the Shanghai
Times. As the people came onto Av.Ed.VII they split up some
running west along Av.Ed.VII and some crossing into F.C.
I fired 2 more shots as they came onto the roadway. I ran
forward to try and arrest one of the men but one of them dressed
in blue jacket and pants turned and threw a hand grenade at me
which missed and exploded in front of the Shanghai Times Bldg.
I then followed the man to Kiangse Rd. where he became lost
in a crowd of people. I noticed about 5 of the men were
dressed in dark coloured Chinese clothes and 1 in a foreign
style light jacket and white pants.
RL
Signed.
pages.zh:
案件编号 919
弗莱明 (Fleming) ____ 琼斯 (Jones)
督察 ____ 1930年7月27日 ____ 208

我当时在爱多亚路16C号《字林西报》(Shanghai Times) 大楼外执勤。晚上约8时10分，我突然听到大楼侧面浪安里 (Lang Aung Li) 弄堂内传来枪声。我拔出手枪，探头查看弄堂拐角，看见约十人一边跑向弄堂口一边用手枪射击。我向弄堂内开了两枪，然后迅速撤回，在《字林西报》大楼的门洞内隐蔽。当那些人跑到爱多亚路上时，他们分散开来，一些人沿爱多亚路向西奔跑，一些人穿过马路进入法租界 (F.C.)。当他们跑到马路上时，我又开了两枪。我向前跑去试图逮捕其中一人，但一名身穿蓝衣蓝裤的男子转身向我投掷了一枚手榴弹，手榴弹未击中我，在《字林西报》大楼前爆炸。随后我跟随该男子至江西路，但他消失在人群中。我注意到约有五人身穿深色中式服装，一人身穿西式浅色夹克和白裤子。
RL
签名。

pages.en:
U.I.S.S. 570
Shan tung Jones
11.10p.m. 22/7/39 C.D.C. 208

At about 8.20p.m. 22/7/39 I was on traffic patrol between
Kiangse and Szechuen Rd. on Av.Ed.VII. I had just placed 3
ricsha cushions inside the Shanghai Times Bldg for safe keeping,
when suddenly I heard an explosion immediately followed by
shooting in the lane Kun. Li. I located my pistol and waited
in the doorway for the criminals to appear.

I saw 7 or 8 men one of whom fired a pistol at me rush
out of the lane. I returned the fire, giving 7 shots but I
don't know whether I hit him or not. I stopped a moment
to get my whistle out when the man got lost in the crowd. I
did not see or hear any bomb after the people left the lane.

The man who fired at me was dressed in a blue jacket and
pants, (Chinese clothing).

Signed.
pages.zh:
印籍巡捕编号 570
山顿·琼斯 (Shan tung Jones)
1939年7月22日 晚11时10分 西捕编号 208

1939年7月22日晚约8时20分，我正在爱多亚路江西路与四川路之间执行交通巡逻任务。我刚将三个黄包车坐垫放入《字林西报》大楼内妥善保管，突然听到一声爆炸，紧接着昆里 (Kun. Li.) 弄堂内传来枪声。我找到手枪，在门洞内等待罪犯出现。

我看见七八名男子冲出弄堂，其中一人向我开枪。我还击，共发射七发子弹，但不知是否击中他。我停顿片刻取出哨子时，该男子已消失在人群中。人群离开弄堂后，我没有看到或听到任何炸弹爆炸。

向我开枪的男子身穿蓝衣蓝裤（中式服装）。

签名。

pages.en:
C.I.C. 464
... Jones
11p.m. 22/7/8 S.I. Hsu

At about 8.10p.m. I was on duty at 172 Av.Ed.Vll when I
suddenly heard shooting and then an explosion inside the Zeng
Kung Li, alleyway. I loaded my pistol and waited in the
entrance to No.172 Av.Ed.Vll. More than 10 people rushed out
of the lane and made off in various directions South and West.
C.I.C. 2919 then came to my post and we both gave chase but I
failed to apprehend any body. I did not fire because I could
not distinguish between pedestrians and criminals. I did not
see any bomb thrown.

Signed.
pages.zh:
华探编号 464
... 琼斯 (Jones)
1938年7月22日 晚11时 高级督察 徐 (S.I. Hsu)

晚上约8时10分，我正在爱多亚路172号执勤，突然听到增庆里 (Zeng Kung Li) 弄堂内传来枪声，随后是一声爆炸。我装好子弹，在爱多亚路172号入口处等待。十多人从弄堂里冲出来，向南和西各个方向逃散。华探编号2919随后来到我的岗位，我们两人一起追赶，但我未能抓获任何人。由于无法区分行人和罪犯，我没有开枪。我没有看到有人投掷炸弹。

签名。

pages.en:
C.P.C. 1895 Hoong Yoong Kwei.
Shantung                                xx  C.P.C. 175
Central Stn.           26-7-39

    C.P.C. 1895 Hoong Yoong Kwei (Yangtsepoo Station) at present
temporarily attached to Central Station, age 25, Shantung, single,
joined the S.M.P. about a year ago, residing Room 601 Police
quarters Central Station.
    Between 5 p.m. 22-7-39 and 1 a.m. 23-7-39 I was on plain
clothes duty posted at Nos. 160 & 162 Avenue Edward VII. At
about 8.20 p.m. 23-7-39 whilst I was walking in Lane 158 Zang
Kung Lee outside the Chung Kuo Daily News Office, No. 130, a
party of more than 8 culprits suddenly entered the lane, holding
Mauser pistols in their hands. Owing to insufficient light I
could not recognise them clearly, only to see that some of them
were wearing foreign style clothing and others wearing short
jackets and pants of various colours. On seeing that 7 or 8
persons all armed with Mauser pistols were surrounding C.P.C.
1472 I immediately concealed myself in a place about 10 yards
away from them and then fired upon them. Having fired all the
shots in the magazine I turned out of the lane when I saw C.P.C.
2919 who was on duty outside the Shanghai Times premises. I then
advised him to blow his whistle and I also did the same. However,
no one responded. I then hid myself behind an electric pole
outside No. 160 and changed another magazine. At this time, I
saw the culprits leave the lane and again fired another shot,
whereupon they all opened fire at me, some throwing hand-grenades
I then felt that my leg had been wounded but I could still walk,
so I immediately walked towards Kiangse Road where I boarded a
trolley bus. The pains on my leg stopped me from firing further
shots. I then again alighted from the trolley bus and walked
towards Avenue Edward VII along the west side of Kiangse Road
when I could not walk any further and collapsed on the ground.
At this moment a foreign detective approached me and took away
my pistol, and the ambulance conveyed me to the Police Hospital.
R/
                                        Sgd: Hoong Yoong Kwei.
pages.zh:
华捕编号 1895 洪永贵 (Hoong Yoong Kwei)。
山东                                xx  华捕编号 175
中央巡捕房           1939年7月26日

    华捕编号1895 洪永贵 (Hoong Yoong Kwei)（杨树浦巡捕房），目前临时隶属于中央巡捕房，年龄25岁，山东人，单身，约一年前加入工部局警务处，居住于中央巡捕房警察宿舍601室。
    1939年7月22日下午5时至7月23日凌晨1时期间，我身着便衣在爱多亚路160号和162号执勤。1939年7月23日晚约8时20分，当我走在增庆里 (Zang Kung Lee) 158号弄堂、《中国日报》(Chung Kuo Daily News) 办公室130号门外时，一伙八名以上的罪犯突然进入弄堂，手中持有毛瑟手枪。由于光线不足，我无法清晰辨认他们，只看到其中一些人穿着西式服装，其他人穿着各种颜色的短夹克和裤子。看到七八名手持毛瑟手枪的人包围了华捕编号1472，我立即隐藏在距离他们约10码的地方，并向他们开火。打光弹匣内的所有子弹后，我转出弄堂，当时看见华捕编号2919正在《字林西报》办公处外执勤。我建议他吹哨，我也同样做了。然而，无人响应。随后我躲在160号外的一根电线杆后，更换了一个弹匣。此时，我看见罪犯离开弄堂，再次开了一枪，于是他们全部向我开火，有些人还投掷手榴弹。我当时感到腿部受伤，但仍能行走，便立即走向江西路，登上了一辆电车。腿部的疼痛使我无法继续射击。随后我再次下车，沿江西路西侧向爱多亚路方向行走，直到无法再走，瘫倒在地。此时一名外籍探员走近我，拿走了我的手枪，救护车将我送往警察医院。
R/
                                        签名：洪永贵 (Hoong Yoong Kwei)。

pages.en:
Lieu Zung lob.
Shantung                      xx  .D.S.  .36.
Central stn.

C.P.C. 1580 Lieu Zung lob, attached to Central Police
station, age 29, Shantung, married, residing Room 504 Police
quarters Central Station.
At about 8.20p.m. July 22, 1939, whilst I was on traffic
duty at the corner of Cato Road and Kiangse Road I heard the
firing of a gun from the direction of Avenue Edward VII
east of Kiangse Road. Thinking that there must be some
culprits creating disturbances towards certain newspaper offices
I immediately loaded my pistol, held it in my hand and ran
towards Avenue Edward VII along the west side of Kiangse Road.
When I was at a distance of about 30 yards away from Avenue
Edward VII I again heard the explosion of a bomb from the north-
east direction at a place not far away from me, and at the same
time small pieces of mud were blown into my face. At this
moment I observed 5 or 6 persons, all armed with Mauser pistols,
appearing from Avenue Edward VII and were running northward
along the east side footpath of Kiangse Road. I then
immediately hid myself in a barber shop (name and number unknown)
on the west side of Kiangse Road. When they passed the barber
shop on the opposite side I saw that the first 3 men were wearing
Chinese clothing and the 2 men behind wearing dark grey and
light grey foreign style suits. Seeing that nobody was chasing
behind them I then came out of the barber shop and followed
after them. When I was about 10 yards away from them I opened
fire at the one who wore dark grey suit, whereupon the two men
wearing foreign dresses immediately turned back and also fired
at me. I felt one of their shots had penetrated into my right
pages.zh:
刘宗洛 (Lieu Zung lob)。
山东                      xx  .D.S.  .36.
中央巡捕房

华捕编号1580 刘宗洛 (Lieu Zung lob)，隶属中央巡捕房，年龄29岁，山东人，已婚，居住于中央巡捕房警察宿舍504室。
1939年7月22日晚约8时20分，当我在凯托路 (Cato Road) 与江西路拐角处执行交通勤务时，听到爱多亚路方向、江西路以东传来枪声。心想定是有罪犯在某些报社附近滋事，我立即装好手枪，持枪在手，沿江西路西侧向爱多亚路跑去。当我距离爱多亚路约30码时，再次听到不远处东北方向传来炸弹爆炸声，同时泥块碎片溅到我脸上。此时，我观察到五六名手持毛瑟手枪的人从爱多亚路出现，并沿江西路东侧人行道向北奔跑。我随即隐藏在江西路西侧的一家理发店（名称和门牌号不详）内。当他们经过对面的理发店时，我看到前三人穿着中式服装，后面的两人穿着深灰色和浅灰色的西式西装。见身后无人追赶，我便走出理发店跟随他们。当我距离他们约10码时，我向穿深灰色西装的人开火，随即两名穿西式服装的男子立即转身向我还击。我感到其中一枪击穿了我的右

pages.en:
-2-
leg and then I collapsed on the footpath. I could not open
fire any further and as far as I can remember I had fired 3
shots altogether. After I fell on the ground they also stopped
firing. The man with dark grey suit seemed also wounded as he
embraced his abdomen with his hand and walked in a zig-zag
way. Then two of his accomplices wearing Chinese short jacket
came and assisted him to walk about 50 yards along the west
side of Kiangse Road and then entered a M/car which was parked
there. After all of them had mounted, the car was driven off
in a northerly direction. About 5 or 6 minutes later I was
conveyed to the Police Hospital where I handed the pistol to
a doctor. I am now still detained in the hospital.
RL
Signed: C.I.C. 1580 Lieu Zung
Poh.
pages.zh:
-2-
腿，随后我倒在人行道上。我无法继续开火，据我所记，我总共开了三枪。我倒地后，他们也停止了射击。穿深灰色西装的男子似乎也受了伤，因为他用手捂着腹部，踉跄行走。随后，他的两名身穿中式短夹克的同伙上前搀扶他，沿江西路西侧走了约50码，然后进入了一辆停在那里的摩托车 (M/car)。所有人上车后，车辆向北驶离。约五六分钟后，我被送往警察医院，并将手枪交给了一名医生。我目前仍被留院治疗。
RL
签名：华探编号 1580 刘宗洛 (Lieu Zung Poh)。

pages.en:
Ngan Sz Tsung, states as follows:-

Central Stn.      22-7-39.

    At about 2.15p.m. today (22/7/39) there suddenly came
more than ten persons who ordered the watchman not to move
and entered the type setting room of the China Evening News,
130 Zang Kung Lee alleyway. Following the pistol shots
fired by the said marauders tumult existed and noise proceeding
from the type setting room were audible. Two workers
consisting of Wang Sil Ming and Koo Jing Zu received bullet
wounds, the former was suffering from bullet wound in
abdomen while the latter was unknown to me. Three type
shelves fell onto the floor. A few minutes later, I heard
many pistol shots fired at the mouth of the alleyway. When
the pistol shots were over, I came out and reported the
incident to the manager by telephone.
    My name is Koo Sz Tsung, I am employed as a clerk in
the General Affairs Dept. of the China Evening News, residing
in Room 209, 2nd floor, Zang Kung Lee alleyway. The said
room is occupied by my family consisting of my mother,
brother and wife. I have been working with the China
Evening News for over seven years.
    Afterwards the police came to the scene and I
accompanied them to the station. When the incident took
place I hid myself in a safe place, therefore I am unable
to furnish any descriptions of the assailants.

                Sgd.
pages.zh:
颜思宗 (Ngan Sz Tsung) 陈述如下：-

中央巡捕房      1939年7月22日。

    今天（1939年7月22日）下午约2时15分，突然来了十多人，命令看门人不得动弹，并进入了增庆里 (Zang Kung Lee) 弄堂130号《中国晚报》(China Evening News) 的排字房。继上述劫掠者开枪后，一片混乱，排字房内传出噪音。两名工人王思明 (Wang Sil Ming) 和顾敬祖 (Koo Jing Zu) 受枪伤，前者腹部中弹，后者伤情我不清楚。三个排字架倒在地上。几分钟后，我听到弄堂口传来许多枪声。枪声停止后，我出来并通过电话向经理报告了此事。
    我叫顾思宗 (Koo Sz Tsung) [注：此处英文署名与开头陈述人姓名拼音不一致，原文如此]，受雇于《中国晚报》总务部担任职员，居住在增庆里弄堂二楼209室。该房间由我的家人居住，包括我的母亲、兄弟和妻子。我在《中国晚报》工作已超过七年。
    随后警察到达现场，我陪同他们前往巡捕房。事发时我躲在安全的地方，因此无法提供袭击者的任何描述。

                签名。

pages.en:
Wong Vang Zai.
Haimen.
Central Stn. 22-7-39.

Wong Vung Zai, aged 32 years, employed as a teaboy and
residing at the Tung Wei Trust Company, 150 Ave. Edward VII.
At sometime past 8 o'clock in the afternoon of the
22nd inst., whilst I together with three others were
enjoying fresh breeze outside the back entrance of the
mentioned firm, I heard pistol shots and I hurriedly ran
into the premises. The pistols shots were audible proceeding
against our back door, we then ran to the shop front toward
outside of the counter. When the vicinity was quiet, I
then emerged from the house proceeding to the rear of the
house where I found my colleague named Ching Zai Sung, a
teaboy who was suffering from bullet wounds lying dead
at the door of Land Dept. of our company. I am not in the
position to identify the assailants. The above is my
true statement.
〔此处转录不清〕
Sgd.
pages.zh:
黄旺仔（音译）。
海门。
中央捕房 1939年7月22日。

黄旺仔（音译），32岁，职业为茶房，居住于爱多亚路150号同威信托公司。
本月22日下午8时许，我与另外三人在上述商号后门处乘凉时，听到枪声，便急忙跑进屋内。枪声似乎是从我们后门方向传来的，随后我们跑到店堂柜台外侧。当周围安静下来后，我从屋内出来走到屋后，发现我的同事、茶房郑子松（音译）身中枪弹，倒毙在我公司地政部门口。我无法指认袭击者。以上是我的真实陈述。
〔此处转录不清〕
签名。

pages.en:
Han Ping Chong.
Tientsin.                      xx C.D.S. 12.
Central Stn.           :2-7-39

    Han Ping Chong, 51,T entsin,M/chauffeur No. 59,employ d by
Shanghai Tram ay Co. and residing at 214 Kong Ka Jao.
    At about 7.50p.m. 22-7-39 I proceeded to Carter Road to
relieve my fellow-worker and I drove tram No. 257. At about
8.12p.m. I drove my tram to Kiangse Road near Canton Road. When
I heard shooting being in progress in the vicinity of Avenue
Edward VII. I therefore stopped my tram and all passengers
alighted. I also dismounted and took refuge. After the
shooting affray ceased, I felt a pain on my left leg and
also discovered a wound. I was therefore sent to Hospital
by ambulance.
                                Signed: Han Ping Chong.
pages.zh:
韩平崇（音译）。
天津。                      xx C.D.S. 12.
中央捕房           1939年7月2日

    韩平崇（音译），51岁，天津人，电车司机，编号59，受雇于上海电车公司，居住于康家桥214号。
    1939年7月22日晚7时50分左右，我前往卡特路接替同事，驾驶257号电车。晚8时12分左右，我将电车开到江西路靠近广东路处。当我听到爱多亚路附近发生枪战时，我便停下电车，所有乘客下车。我也下车躲避。枪战结束后，我感到左腿疼痛，并发现一处伤口。因此由救护车将我送往医院。
                                签名：韩平崇（音译）。

pages.en:
Ma Yao Vung.
Honan.                                C.D.C. 175.
Xentral Stn.          22-7-39

      Ma Yao Vung, age 35, S/master of cake shop, residing at
the mouth of Zang Kung Lee.
      At about 8p.m. 22/7/39 I was cutting fire-wood at the
mouth of the Zong Kung Lee, when a number of over 10 men
wearing foreign clothes, and black Cantonese silk short
jackets and pants respectively entered the alleyway, as
far as the back door of the China Evening News. Then I
heard a series of gunshots. After five minutes they
emerged from the alleyway. However they kept shooting
whilst rushing out the alleyway. They walked along Ave.
Edward VII and turned into Kiangse Road. I observed the
occurrence as I was at that time lying on the ground.
I did not observe any more than stated above.

                        Cross-agd.
pages.zh:
马耀荣（音译）。
河南。                                C.D.C. 175.
中央捕房          1939年7月22日

      马耀荣（音译），35岁，饼店师傅，居住于张公黎（音译）弄口。
      1939年7月22日晚8时许，我正在张公黎（音译）弄口劈柴，此时有十余名身穿西装及黑色粤式丝绸短衫短裤的男子分别进入弄堂，一直走到《中国晚报》社的后门。随后我听到一连串枪声。五分钟后他们从弄堂里出来。然而他们在冲出弄堂时持续开枪。他们沿着爱多亚路行走，转入江西路。我当时躺在地上，目睹了这一事件。除上述情况外，我未观察到其他情形。

                        交叉询问。

pages.en:
Wo Kai Nyoh.
Tung-dai, Pompo
XX C.D.S. 236
Central Stn. 26-7-39

Woo Kai Nyoh, aged 35 years, native of Tung-dai, Pompo,
M/public ricsha coolie, badge No. 38545, residing at No. 23 Nyih
Shing Lee, Rue Bourgeat, F.C.

At 2p.m. on July 22nd, I hired a public ricsha, Lic.No. 6725
from the foreman named Zau Fung who is in the employ of Fong Kee
Ricsha Hong, branch Office, situated in the near vicinity of my
home. Before I received injury in the shooting affray, I took
a foreign lady in my ricsha from Rue Vallon to a cafe in Rue Chu
Pao San, F.C. At sometime after 8p.m. I parked my ricsha outside
Yoong Kyih Lee (Lane No. 31) off Kiangse Road to await for a fare.
Meanwhile I heard the sound of explosion coming from the south
of Avenue Edward VII and all the pedestrians on Avenue Edward VII
took their heels in a northerly direction along Kiangse Road,
hiding themselves in various alleyways. At the time they were
running, they stated that someone had thrown hand-grenades. On
hearing this, I immediately left my ricsha and entered the Yoong
Kyih Lee alleyway to evade danger. Upon entering the alleyway
I further heard the sound of repeated pistol shots firing in the
southern direction. After I remained 4 or 5 minutes in the
alleyway, I went outside with intent to remove my ricsha into the
lane, but on arriving at the pavement I was suffering great pain
on my left knee and foot bleeding profusely. I was, at loss to
know the cause for sustaining such injury, nor could I know which
direction the bullet came from. I was compelled to sit on the
ground and observed a number of police, all armed with pistols
rushing from Kiangse Road toward Avenue Edward VII. About 10
minutes later, a Chinese constable came to the scene and conveyed
me to the Lester Chinese Hospital where I was detained for
pages.zh:
吴开若（音译）。
浦东，东岱（音译）
XX C.D.S. 236
中央捕房 1939年7月26日

吴开若（音译），35岁，籍贯浦东东岱（音译），职业为公共人力车夫，徽章号38545，居住于法租界蒲石路23号益兴里。

7月22日下午2时，我向家住附近的丰记车行分行的工头赵凤（音译）租用了一辆牌照号为6725的公共人力车。在枪战中受伤前，我拉着一位外国女士从瓦隆路前往法租界朱葆三路的一家咖啡馆。晚8时过后，我将人力车停在江西路旁永吉里（31弄）外等候客人。期间，我听到爱多亚路南面传来爆炸声，爱多亚路上的所有行人均沿江西路向北逃窜，躲入各条弄堂。他们在奔跑时说有人投掷手榴弹。听到这话，我立即离开人力车，进入永吉里弄堂以躲避危险。进入弄堂后，我又听到南面传来连续的枪声。我在弄堂里待了四五分钟后，打算出去将人力车移入弄内，但走到人行道上时，我感到左膝剧痛，脚部大量出血。我不知道是如何受伤的，也不知道子弹来自哪个方向。我被迫坐在地上，看到数名手持手枪的警察从江西路冲向爱多亚路。大约10分钟后，一名华捕来到现场，将我送往莱斯德华人医院，我被留院接受

pages.en:
-2-

treatment. At the time I was standing outside the Young Kyih Lee
alleyway Kiangse Road, I did not see anyone firing pistol or
throwing hand-grenade, nor I knew the cause of such a shooting
affray. At 9a.m. 26-7-39, I was discharged from the hospital
as instructed by the doctor and was brought to the station
to make the above statement.
AK
                                Signed: Woo Kai Nyoh.
pages.zh:
-2-

治疗。当时我站在江西路永吉里弄堂外，没有看到任何人开枪或投掷手榴弹，也不知道此次枪战的起因。1939年7月26日上午9时，遵医嘱出院，并被带到捕房作上述陈述。
AK
                                签名：吴开若（音译）。

pages.en:
Zee Ling Nyoeh.
Shan tung.                                C.D.S. 36.
Central Stn.          22-7-39.

    Zee Ling Nyoeh, age 18, apprentice, 45 Kiangse Road.
    At about 8p.m. 22/7/39 on my way back from an errand
of delivering meals to the Hung Mer Lee, Kiangse Road, I
observed 3 m/cars (one black and the other 2 silver coloured)
approaching from north. They stopped outside Nyi Zung
Hardware Shop, 42 Kiangse Road (the black one was followed
by the two silver coloured cars). At that time I heard a
shooting affray taking place in the vicinity of Ave Edward
VII., A policeman who leaned against an electric pole situated
outside my shop blew his whistle when he observed a number of
men alighting from the black m/car. The passengers then
immediately opened fire at the C.P.C. and also threw one
hand grenade. I instantly rushed to my shop, however I
felt a pain on my both right and left legs. I was then
immediately removed to the St. Luke's Hospital for treatment.
    I have to say that House 42 Kiangse Road is just
slightly opposite my shop (Van Foh Chu Restaurant).

                                    Sgd.
pages.zh:
谢林约（音译）。
山东。                                C.D.S. 36.
中央捕房          1939年7月22日。

    谢林约（音译），18岁，学徒，江西路45号。
    1939年7月22日晚8时许，我在去江西路鸿美利（音译）送饭回来的路上，观察到3辆汽车（一辆黑色，另两辆银色）从北面驶来。它们停在江西路42号义成五金店外（黑色车在前，两辆银色车在后）。当时我听到爱多亚路附近发生枪战。一名倚靠在我店外电线杆上的警察在看到几名男子从黑色汽车上下来时吹响了哨子。乘客随即向该华捕开火，并投掷了一枚手榴弹。我立刻冲回店内，但感到双腿疼痛。随后我立即被送往圣路加医院治疗。
    我要说明的是，江西路42号就在我的店铺（万福厨餐厅）斜对面。

                                    签名。

pages.en:
Tsang Hong Tsing.
xx C.D.S. 236
Central Stn. 29-7-39

Tsang Hong Tsing, aged 42 years, S/handcart coolie, N.F.A.
At about 3p.m. on July 22nd, this year, whilst I was in
the vicinity of Butterfield & Swire wharf, I was engaged by an
unknown handcart owner as a casual coolie in company with 3
others to pull a handcart (licence number unknown) loaded with
sugar to the Wong Dah Sung General Goods Shop, situated at
Shanhaikwan and Carter Roads corner. On arriving at the
destination, we unloaded the sugar and returned with an empty
handcart.
At about 8.30p.m. we parked the handcart outside the China
Evening News, 160 Avenue Edward VII with aim to buy a piece of
candle to have the lantern lighted which was a necessary
measure to prevent violating traffic regulations in the French
Concession. When we were about to pull the handcart after having
lighted the candle we suddenly heard the sound of repeated pistol
shots coming from the mouth of Zang Kung Lee alleyway, north side
of Avenue Edward VII. At that time the pedestrians on the road-
way were seen hiding themselves by lying on the ground and I also
lay on the ground in the opposite of the said newspaper concern
in order to avoid being injured by stray bullets. About 2 or 3
minutes later, I received a bullet wound in the back and the
wound profusely bled. About 10 minutes later, a foreign soldier
came and helped me to board a motor-car and I was subsequently
conveyed to the Lester Chinese Hospital.
In the afternoon of July 29th, this year, I was discharged
from the hospital and escorted to the Central Police Station,
where I was interrogated regarding the details of the shooting
affray. After receiving injuries I was, at loss to know as to
where and how the handcart had been taken away. The above is
my true statement.
Sgd: Tsang Hong Tsing.
pages.zh:
曾洪清（音译）。
xx C.D.S. 236
中央捕房 1939年7月29日

曾洪清（音译），42岁，职业为手推车苦力，非正式雇员。
今年7月22日下午3时许，我在太古码头附近，受一名未知姓名的手推车车主雇佣，作为临时苦力，与其他三人一起拉一辆手推车（牌照号不详），车上装载白糖，运往位于山海关路与卡特路路角的王大生百货店。到达目的地后，我们卸下白糖，拉着空车返回。
晚8时30分左右，我们将手推车停在爱多亚路160号《中国晚报》社外，打算买一支蜡烛点亮灯笼，这是为了防止违反法租界交通法规的必要措施。当我们点好蜡烛准备拉车时，突然听到爱多亚路北侧张公黎（音译）弄口传来连续的枪声。当时看到路上的行人纷纷趴在地上躲避，我也趴在报社对面的地上，以免被流弹击中。大约两三分钟后，我背部中弹，伤口大量出血。大约10分钟后，一名外籍士兵前来帮助我上了一辆汽车，随后我被送往莱斯德华人医院。
今年7月29日下午，我出院后被护送至中央捕房，就枪战细节接受讯问。受伤后，我不知道手推车被何人如何拉走。以上是我的真实陈述。
签名：曾洪清（音译）。

"A"
2155/39.             Central
                     July 29th,           39.
          7.                                1.

Threatening Letter
received by the
China Evening News

A threatening letter addressed to the Manager of
the British-owned "China Evening News" was delivered
through the post at the offices of the newspaper on
July 26.

The letter is written in English and is signed the
"Leader" the skull and crossbones are also drawn under-
neath the signature.

The letter reads as follows:-
                     ( COPY )
                                          July 24, 1939

"To The Manager
China Evening News

Dear Manager,

     I've the power in sending you this
letter to you and warning you for your
further publishing the China Polin (?)
if you don't want your press to be wreck
again I want you to stop publishing your
China Evening News at least one week if
you shall fail my demand I'll send my
man to kill every member on your staff.
Now listen to me when you receive this
letter I am warning you don't call the
police for your safety if you know what
is good for you. The two phone call wo

"A"
2155/39.             中央
                     1939年7月29日，           39.

《中国晚报》
收到的恐吓信

一封写给英商《中国晚报》经理的恐吓信于7月26日通过邮递送达该报办公室。

该信用英文书写，署名为“首领”（Leader），签名下方还画有骷髅和交叉骨图案。

信件内容如下：
                     （副本）
                                          1939年7月24日

“致经理
《中国晚报》

亲爱的经理：

     我有能力给你写这封信并警告你，如果你不想你的报社再次被毁，就停止进一步出版《中国波兰人报？》（China Polin (?)）。我希望你至少停刊《中国晚报》一周，如果你不满足我的要求，我将派人杀死你所有的员工。现在听我说，当你收到这封信时，我警告你不要为了你的安全而报警，如果你知道什么对你有好处的话。那两次电话呼叫 wo

7/sheet 2.

call you over the telephone you had
reported to police i am warning you
don't do it again. Now listen to me
you may start to publishing begain on
the 1st August not before. I am sure
you this letter for your warning. So
stop your publishing your paper at
present. I am the ring leader I meant
business this time if you fail my
demand every member on your staff will
be kill.

THE LEADER
〔此处转录不清：一个手绘的卡通小人图案〕

July 24, 1939.

To The Manager
China Evening News

Dear Manager,

I've the power in sending you this letter to you and
warning you for your further publishing the China Polin(?) if you
don't want your press to be wreck again I want you to stop publishing
your China Evening News at least one week if you shall fail my demand
I'll send my man to kill every member on your staff. Now listen to
me when you receive this letter I am warning you don't call the police
for your safety if you know what is good for you. The two phone call
we call you over the telephone you had reported to police I am warning
you don't do it again. Now listen to me you may start to publishing
again on the 1st August not before. I am sure you this letter for
your warning. So stop your publishing your paper at present. I am
the ring leader I meant business this time if you fail my demand
every member on your staff will be kill.

THE LEADER

《中国晚报》经理

pages.en:
2155/39.
"A"
Central
27th July
39.
b.
1.

Threatening letters
received by Chinese
employees of the
Chinese-American
Daily News.

Some 19 Chinese employees of the Chinese-
American Daily News were the recipients of
threatening letters on the morning of July 26.
All letters were delivered through the Post and
bear the Seymour Road and Bubbling Well Road Sub-
Post Office post marks.

The writer claims to be a supporter of "Wang
Ching Wei" and a member of the so-called "China
Kuomintang Communist Elimination & National Salvation
Special Workers General Headquarters."

The letter, which is couched in very strong
language warns the recipients that their lives will
be endangered if they ignore the warning and continue
to serve the Chinese-American Daily News.

The letter translated reads as follows:-
"The Chinese-American Daily News fabricate
untrue news every-day and always make comment
in favour of the Communists. They publish
libelous articles against our leader and
this is detrimental to the existence of the
nation. The punishment given during the
night of the 22-7-39 is just the starting
point. We believe that you work at your
position because you are pressed for money.
pages.zh:
2155/39.
"A"
中央
7月27日
1939年。
b.
1.

《中美日报》
华籍员工收到的
恐吓信。

1939年7月26日上午，《中美日报》约19名华籍员工收到了恐吓信。所有信件均通过邮局投递，并盖有西摩路（Seymour Road）和静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）支局的邮戳。

写信人自称是“汪精卫”的支持者，以及所谓“中国国民党铲共救国特工总部”的成员。

这封信措辞严厉，警告收信人，如果无视警告并继续为《中美日报》服务，他们的生命将受到威胁。

信件译文如下：
“《中美日报》每天编造虚假新闻，并始终发表支持共产党的评论。他们刊登诽谤我们领袖的文章，这对国家的生存有害。1939年7月22日晚给予的惩罚只是一个开始。我们相信，你们之所以在这个职位上工作，是因为经济拮据。

pages.en:
-2-

Your daily expenses will be met by us
should you quit your present position
within the period of 3 days. (You will
be paid as much as by your present
employers, and furthermore you will
not be required to work but just sit
and receive wages). You will be consi-
dered as faithless should you ignore
this letter. If so, we will at sometime
despatch some men to visit your home
and carry out the execution by shooting."
(See Central F.I.R.2192/39).

Information re
persons responsible
for Saturday's
incident.

A letter signed by one named Tsu Yih Tsing (朱益清)
was delivered through the Post to the office of the
Chinese-American Daily News on July 26. It bears
the Szechuen Road Post-mark and is believed to have
been posted on the evening of July 24.
The contents of this letter is interesting and
places the responsibility for the attack on the
newspaper offices on "Wang Ching Wei's Party".
It reads as follows:
pages.zh:
-2-

如果你们在3天内辞去现职，你们的日常开支将由我们承担。（你们将获得与现任雇主支付的同等薪酬，此外，你们无需工作，只需坐着领取工资）。如果你们无视此信，将被视为不忠。若是如此，我们将在某个时候派人拜访你们的家中，并通过枪决执行死刑。”
（参见中央捕房 F.I.R.2192/39）。

关于周六
事件责任人的
情报。

1939年7月26日，一封署名为朱益清（Tsu Yih Tsing）的信件通过邮局送达《中美日报》办公室。该信盖有四川路邮戳，据信于7月24日晚投递。
这封信的内容很有趣，并将袭击报社的责任归咎于“汪精卫党”。
内容如下：

pages.en:
-3-

Dear Editor,
    I hereby furnish you the information
to the effect that the attack on your office
yesterday was carried out by the supporters
of Wang's Party. As I am living in the
vicinity of Edinburgh Road. I have heard and
seen their activities and movements. Further-
more I have had the acquaintance of one of
the gang and I know that most of them are
residing at Nos.5 and 6 Zeu Ching Lee
alleyway as well as No.10 Lane 96 off Edinburgh
Road. The men numbering 20 or 30 are in
possession of Mauser pistols and supported
by the Japanese Authorities. Further attacks
on the "Sun Pao", "Hwa Mei", "Dai Mei","Dai Wan"
and "Tsong Mei" and other newspaper offices
will be carried out in the near future. It is
stated that Wang Ching-Wei is now residing at
Wong Pah Chun's home on Yu Yuen Road. Please
don't disclose the receipt of this letter for
publication, but immediately warn other news-
paper concerns that precautionary measures
should be adopted and secretly refer the matter
to the Settlement Authorities or the "Traitors
pages.zh:
-3-

尊敬的编辑：
    特此向贵方提供信息，昨天对贵社的袭击是由汪派支持者实施的。由于我居住在爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）附近，我听到并看到了他们的活动和动向。此外，我与帮派中的一人有交情，我知道他们大多数人居住在邹庆里（Zeu Ching Lee）弄堂5号和6号，以及爱丁堡路外96弄10号。这些人约有二三十名，拥有毛瑟手枪，并得到日本当局的支持。近期将对《申报》（Sun Pao）、《华美晚报》（Hwa Mei）、《大美晚报》（Dai Mei）、《大晚报》（Dai Wan）和《众美》（Tsong Mei）及其他报社进行进一步袭击。据说汪精卫目前居住在愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）王柏春（Wong Pah Chun）家中。请勿公开披露收到此信以供发表，但应立即警告其他报业机构采取预防措施，并秘密将此事项报告给租界当局或“汉奸

pages.en:
-4-

Suppression Group" with aim to have all
of them apprehended."

Sd. Tsu Yih Tsing, 24-7.

The letter has been passed to Headquarters for
examination.

It can now be authenticly stated that at least
20 terrorists participated in the attack upon the
Chinese-American Daily News and China Evening News
offices and that they set out on their mission from
territory under the control of the Shanghai City
Government.

Statements made by the four Ford Hire Service
chauffeurs definitely settles all argument as to
where the gang came from and furthermore one of the
chauffeurs was compelled to convey five or six of
the men back to Edinburgh Road after the bombing
incident.

Four Ford Hire Cars were engaged by the gang to
take them from DAH SING TSUNG alleyway, off Tse An
Pang (诸安浜), EDINBURGH ROAD at approximately
8.10 p.m. July 22. The cars were not sent in
response to a telephone message, but at the request
of two male Chinese who called at the Ford Hire

Terrorists came
from Chinese
territory off
Edinburgh Road.
pages.zh:
-4-

镇压小组”，旨在将他们全部逮捕。”

签署：朱义清（Tsu Yih Tsing），7月24日。

该信函已转交总局审查。

现可确切陈述，至少有20名恐怖分子参与了对《中美日报》和《中国晚报》社的袭击，且他们是从上海市政府控制区出发执行此次任务的。

四名福特租车行司机的陈述明确解决了关于该团伙来源的所有争议，此外，其中一名司机在爆炸事件发生后被迫将五或六名男子送回爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）。

该团伙雇用了四辆福特出租车，于7月22日晚8点10分左右，从诸安浜（Tse An Pang）爱丁堡路（EDINBURGH ROAD）的大新宗（DAH SING TSUNG）弄堂口接载他们。这些车辆并非响应电话叫车，而是应两名前往爱丁堡路福特租车

恐怖分子来自
爱丁堡路附近的
中国辖区。

pages.en:
-5-

station at Edinburgh Road. The men ordering the cars
spoke Kompo dialect and appeared to be of the coolie
class.
They accompanied the four cars (Nos.12236,12301,
12302, and 12293) to the entrance to the DAH SING
TSUNG alleyway.
At least twenty male Chinese then emerged from
the alleyway and boarded the four cars.
The men are believed to have been of the loafer
class and most of them were wearing black Cantonese
silk, white and blue cloth jackets.
Each chauffeur was instructed to proceed to
Kiangse road,via Great Western Road, Avenue Foch and
Avenue Edward VII.
Most of the occupants of the four cars are
stated to have spoken in the Kompo dialect.
The men on arriving at Kiangse Road immediately
alighted from the cars and proceeded towards the
Shanghai Times Building.
Two men armed with Mauser pistols remained
behind with the cars.
Subsequent events are fully outlined in the
chauffeurs' written statements.
A statement made by C.P.C.1580 to the effect
pages.zh:
-5-

站点的中国男性要求而派出的。叫车的男子讲宁波话（Kompo dialect），看起来属于苦力阶层。
他们随同四辆汽车（车牌号12236、12301、12302和12293）前往大新宗（DAH SING TSUNG）弄堂入口。
随后，至少二十名中国男性从弄堂里出来，登上了这四辆车。
据信这些人属于无业游民阶层，大多数人穿着黑色广东绸以及白色和蓝色布制夹克。
每名司机均被指示经由大西路（Great Western Road）、福煦路（Avenue Foch）和爱德华七世路（Avenue Edward VII）前往江西路（Kiangse road）。
据称，这四辆车上的大多数乘客都讲宁波话（Kompo dialect）。
这些人到达江西路后立即下车，朝《字林西报》大楼（Shanghai Times Building）方向走去。
两名持有毛瑟手枪的男子留在车旁看守车辆。
后续事件在司机的书面陈述中已有详细概述。
警员C.P.C.1580所作陈述称，

pages.en:
-6-

that one of the gunmen had been wounded when running
on Kiangse Road and had been assisted by his
accomplices is corroborated by Tien Ah Foh, the
chauffeur of Motor-car No.12293.

All the occupants numbering 6 or 7 returned
to the Dah Sing Tsung in the above car after the
shooting. One of them was apparently wounded and
had to be assisted out of the car. Each man, according
to the chauffeur, was in possession of a Mauser
pistol or hand-grenade.

The statement made by the chauffeur (Tseu Yoong
Tsang) of car No.12235 definitely shows that the
occupants of this car were involved in this bombing
affray and were on their way back to Edinburgh Road
when an attempt by a Louza Search Party to stop the
vehicle on Hankow Road near Cheking Road resulted
in a shooting affray.

Only one of the terrorists made a get-away in
car No.12301 and at the point of a Mauser pistol
succeeded in making the chauffeur (Tsu Kung Kuo)
drive him to the intersection of Avenue Foch and
Seymour Road, where the chauffeur taking advantage
of the traffic signal being against him jumped out of
the car and fled.
pages.zh:
-6-

其中一名枪手在江西路上奔跑时受伤，并得到同伙协助，这一说法得到了12293号汽车司机田阿福（Tien Ah Foh）的证实。

枪击发生后，上述车辆中的所有乘客（共6或7人）返回大新宗（Dah Sing Tsung）。其中一人显然受伤，需要协助才能下车。据司机称，每人都持有毛瑟手枪或手榴弹。

12235号车司机周永昌（Tseu Yoong Tsang）的陈述明确显示，该车乘客参与了此次爆炸冲突，并在返回爱丁堡路途中，当一辆罗素搜查队（Louza Search Party）的车辆在靠近浙江路（Cheking Road）的汉口路上试图拦截该车时，引发了枪战。

只有一名恐怖分子乘坐122301号车逃脱，并用毛瑟手枪胁迫司机徐公国（Tsu Kung Kuo）将其驾驶至福煦路（Avenue Foch）和西摩路（Seymour Road）交叉口，司机趁交通信号灯对其不利（红灯）之机跳车逃离。

The gunman left a hand-grenade behind in the car.
The driver of car No.12302 (Ma Ah Loh) was
in the vicinity of the Shanghai Times Building when
the shooting took place. He immediately drove off
without any passengers and subsequently abandoned

Ma Ah Loh.
Zeushing.                                D.S.I. Yang.
Central Stn.          22-7-39.

    Ma Ah Loh, 33, residing 80 Markham Road, employed by
Ford Hire Service as a chauffeur, driving permit S.M.C.
No.6676.
    At about 8.07p.m. 22/7/39 I was on duty at the Ford Hire
Service situated at Edinburgh Road, when two male Chinese of
coolie class, spoke Kampo dialect, came and asked for 4 hire
cars. One of the men who is about 45 years old, height about
5'6", medium build, wearing black cloth short jacket and pants,
stated that first was to take some friends to "Tse Ka Pang", at
Edinburgh Road, then to the Great World and the "Koong Woo
Dai" theatre. I was then instructed with the other three hire
cars to take them to "Tse Ka Pang" at Edinburgh Road. On
arrival at the latter place about 50 yards away from our
garage, the man in my car is aged about 21, height about 5'4",
medium build, close cut head, wearing blue short jacket and
pants. The other man who is older than the latter was not in
my car went to the mouth of the "Dah Sing Tsung" alleyway when
I saw about 20 male Chinese, all wearing short jacket and pants
coming out from the said alleyway. Four of these men came to
my car whilst the others went in to the three other cars
which were parking in front of my car. The four men in my
car asked me to follow the front three cars closely. I drove
the car and followed them from Edinburgh Road to the North
of Kiengse Road, via Great Western Road, Ave Foch and Ave
Edward VII. On arrival at Kiengse Road I stopped my car at
the back of the three other cars. The four men in my car then
alighted, and the man who spoke Kampo dialect, asked me to

马阿洛（Ma Ah Loh）。
泽兴（Zeushing，音译）。                                杨督察长（D.S.I. Yang）。
中央巡捕房          1939年7月22日。

    马阿洛，33岁，住马克姆路（Markham Road）80号，受雇于福特租车行担任司机，工部局驾驶执照编号6676。
    1939年7月22日晚8点07分左右，我在位于爱丁堡路的福特租车行值班，当时有两名讲宁波话（Kampo dialect，原文拼写变异）、属苦力阶层的中国男性前来，要求租用4辆出租车。其中一人约45岁，身高约5英尺6英寸，中等身材，身穿黑色布短夹克和裤子，他说先要送一些朋友去爱丁堡路的“诸家浜”（Tse Ka Pang，音译，即诸安浜），然后去大世界和“共舞台”（Koong Woo Dai）剧院。随后我奉命与其他三辆出租车一起送他们去爱丁堡路的“诸家浜”。到达离我们要车库约50码的该地点时，我车上的那名男子约21岁，身高约5英尺4英寸，中等身材，平头，身穿蓝色短夹克和裤子。另一名比后者年长的男子不在我车上，他去了“大新宗”（Dah Sing Tsung）弄堂口，此时我看见约20名中国男性，均穿短夹克和裤子，从该弄堂出来。其中四人走向我的车，其余人进入停在我车前的其他三辆车。我车上的四人让我紧跟前面三辆车。我驾车从爱丁堡路经大西路、福煦路和爱德华七世路，跟随他们至江西路（Kiengse Road，原文拼写变异）北侧。到达江西路后，我将车停在那三辆车后面。我车上的四人随后下车，那名讲宁波话的人让我

turn back the car. They then accompanied the men alighted

    赵宗国，37岁，住新闸路（Sinza Road）终点南姚（Nan Yao，音译）某无门牌房屋。
    我受雇于福特租车公司担任司机（公共马车执照3087号）。
    1939年7月22日晚8点10分左右，我驾驶12301号机动车前往爱丁堡路站，此时会计宋子白（Sung Ts Bai，音译）先生通知我有人预订了4辆车。他指令我驾车前去应召。我与其他3辆车一同驶往诸安浜（Ts An Pang）附近的大新宗（Dah Sing Tsung），我的车排在第3位。到达上述地点后，我注意到前两辆车停下，我也随之停车。我观察到路边等候着17至18名男性，大多数人穿着黑色广东绸或蓝色短夹克。其中四人登上我的车，一名穿布夹克的男子坐在我旁边。后者指令我驶往靠近江西路的爱德华七世路（Ave Riw. VII，原文缩写及拼写错误，指Avenue Edward VII）。我跟随前两辆车，停在靠近爱德华七世路的江西路口拐角处，车头朝北。坐在后排的4名乘客下车并向东行进。坐在我旁边的乘客指令我将车掉头。当我将车转向南方时，我听到几声枪响。我感到害怕，便向南驾车。这时他突然掏出手枪，指令我从爱德华七世路向东行驶。然而，当时我的车已到达法租界领事馆路（Rue Consulat F.C.）。他指令我开回诸安浜（Ts An Pang）。因此，我从领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）向

pages.en:

an westerly direction. I drove to Rue Tourane and turned
into Ave Edward VII. Then I turned west to Seymour Road
and Ave Foch on arrival at which place I observed the traffic
light (red) preventing me from farther proceeding. I
stopped and jumped out from the car. I ran into Rue du Roi
Albert F.C. and eventually arrived at Route Vallon Station
where I reported the occurrence to Mr. Yang Ching Yuen.
Afterwards, chauffeur Ma Ah Loh also arrived and reported
his story. We three then came to Central Police Station
and made a report.

Tseu Yoong Tsang, 42, M/chauffeur, residing No.18 Waung
Ka Loong off Great Western Road.
At about 8.07p.m. 22/7/39 four Ford Hire M/cars Lic.Nos.
12235, 12301, 12302, and 12293 were ordered to be driven to
Ts An Pang Edinburgh Road and I was driving one of the cars
Lic.No.12235. On arrival at the destination 6 men, 5 wearing
black jackets and pants, 3 with straw hats, and 1 wearing white
jacket and pants (now detained in hospital) boarded my car
the latter described male Chinese occupying the front seat
whilst the other five male Chinese seated at the back, one
of whom telling me to drive to Ave Edward VII. The man who
seated with me then instructed me to drive along Great Western
Road east to Ave Foch, Ave Edward VII, Kiangse Road north to
Canton Road when I was told to stop and at the same time the
other three cars following behind my car also stopped. The
5 occupants of my car, all in black clothing and armed with
pistols, alighted from it and walked away quickly south on
Canton Road. At about 10 minutes later they returned in a
great hurry and excited manner when I was told by the man in
white clothing to drive them back. Since then I lost sight of
the other 3 cars and the passengers in it which were ranked
behind my car. When they got into the car I drove on along
Kiangse Road, Hankow Road, west to Chekiang Road where about
5 policemen gave signal to stop. I intended to stop my car
but the man dressed in white seated with me produced a pistol
and struck it to my waist ordering me to increase the speed.
On approaching the policemen I slowed my speed and this

周永昌，42岁，机动车司机，住大西路（Great Western Road）附近汪家弄（Waung Ka Loong，音译）18号。
1939年7月22日晚8点07分左右，四辆福特租赁机动车（执照号12235、12301、12302和12293）被指令驶往爱丁堡路诸安浜（Ts An Pang Edinburgh Road），我驾驶其中一辆执照号为12235的汽车。到达目的地后，6名男子上车，其中5人穿黑色夹克和裤子，3人戴草帽，1人穿白色夹克和裤子（现羁押在医院），后者描述为坐在前排的中国男性，其余五名中国男性坐在后排，其中一人指令我驶往爱德华七世路。坐在我旁边的男子随后指令我沿大西路向东行驶，经福煦路、爱德华七世路、江西路向北至广东路，此时我被告知停车，同时跟随在我车后的其他三辆车也停了下来。我车上的5名乘客均身着黑衣并携带手枪，下车后迅速沿广东路向南走去。约10分钟后，他们匆忙且兴奋地返回，此时穿白衣的男子指令我送他们回去。此后我便失去了跟在我车后的其他三辆车及其乘客的踪迹。当他们上车后，我继续沿江西路、汉口路向西行驶至浙江路（Chekiang Road），此时约5名警察发出停车信号。我本打算停车，但坐在我旁边的白衣男子掏出手枪抵住我的腰部，命令我加速。接近警察时我放慢了车速，这

pages.en:
- 2 -
apparently made, the man become suspicious resulting in him
firing a shot. I immediately stopped the car and jumped
out by opening the side door and ran/hid myself into the Ching
Yi Suh Restaurant on Hankow Road whereupon a shooting took
place outside the premises for about 6 or 7 minutes. After
another 20 minutes I came out from the restaurant and
proceeded to the entrance of the Tung Fong Lodging House
Hankow Road where I had stopped the car when a Chinese
policeman approached me and brought me to the station after
ascertaining that I was the chauffeur of this car. Later
I was taken to the Police Hospital where I saw a wounded man
dressed in white and identified him as the man who had
seated with me in the car and fired the shot.
RL
（批：Who 28/7）

显然引起了该男子的怀疑，导致他开了一枪。我立即停车，打开侧门跳下，跑进/躲进汉口路上的清一色餐厅（Ching Yi Suh Restaurant，音译），随后店外发生了持续约6或7分钟的枪战。又过了20分钟，我从餐厅出来，前往汉口路东方旅馆（Tung Fong Lodging House）入口，我当时已将车停在那里，一名中国警察走近我，在确认我是该车司机后将我带往警局。后来我被带到警察医院，在那里我看到一名受伤的白衣男子，并认出他就是曾与我同车并开枪的那个人。
RL

Lic.9402) Edinburgh Road Ford Hire Station.

22-7-39

I am a chauffeur and reside at 173 Loo Sih Zah off
Brenan Road.

At about 8.10p.m. 22/7/39 3 male Chinese in shorts
visited the station and wanted the service of 4 cars. The
cars were requested to be sent to Ts An Pang, off Edinburgh
Road. I was then instructed to drive Car No.12293 together
with the other three. As the men who made the order did
not oc py my car I did not have full view of them, I only
observed one of them wearing white short jacket. Upon arrival
at Dah Sing Tsung off Ts An Pang, I observed a number of about
5 males wearing black Cantonese silk and white and also blue
cloth jackets. They spoke with either Kompo or Yangchow
accent. These 5 persons boarded my car. The remaining three
cars were also occupied by 4 or 5 men in shorts respectively.
The 4 cars were all instructed to drive to Ave Edward VII
near Kiangse Road. This was done via Great Western Road, Ave
Foch. Upon arrival at Ave. Edward VII near Kiangse Road,
four of the 5 passengers alighted, whilst the remaining one
(description: dark complexion, long face, height 5'5", slim
build, hair cut short, wearing blue cloth jacket and pants
speaking Shanghai dialect) instructed me at the point of a
Mauser pistol to park the car at the front of the Mum Cabaret
Ave. Edward VII F.C. It was about 8.30p.m. Then I heard a
shooting affray taking place inside the China Press Building.
The single passenger then instructed me at the point of his
pistol to drive back to north of Kiangse near Canton Roads.
A number of 6 or 7 men in shorts hastily boarded my car, in

连阿福（Lien Ah Foh），37岁，上海人，职业：司机（中央汽车行执照号9402），爱丁堡路福特租车行。

1939年7月22日

我是一名司机，居住在勃伦纳路（Brenan Road）旁的路西扎路（Loo Sih Zah）173号。

1939年7月22日晚上8点10分左右，三名身穿短裤的中国男子来到车行，要求租用四辆汽车。他们要求将车派往爱丁堡路旁的泰安坊（Ts An Pang）。随后我奉命驾驶第12293号汽车，与其他三辆车一同前往。由于下单的人并未乘坐我的车，我未能看清他们的全貌，只观察到其中一人身穿白色短夹克。抵达泰安坊旁的大新宗（Dah Sing Tsung）时，我看到约有五名男子，身穿黑色广东丝绸以及白色和蓝色布制夹克。他们说话带有宁波或扬州口音。这五人上了我的车。其余三辆车也分别载有四或五名穿短裤的男子。这四辆车均被指令驶往靠近江西路的爱德华七世大道（Ave Edward VII）。车队经由大西路（Great Western Road）和福煦路（Ave Foch）前往。抵达靠近江西路的爱德华七世大道后，五名乘客中的四人下车，而剩下的一人（特征：肤色黝黑，长脸，身高5英尺5英寸，身材瘦削，短发，身穿蓝色布夹克和长裤，讲上海话）用一把毛瑟手枪指着我，命令我将车停在爱德华七世大道法租界一侧的“妈妈”舞厅（Mum Cabaret）前。当时约为晚上8点30分。随后，我听到《大美晚报》（China Press）大楼内发生了枪战。那名单独的乘客再次用枪指着我，命令我开车返回靠近广东路的江西路北段。六或七名穿短裤的男子匆忙上了我的车，在

pages.en:
- 2 -
whose possession I observed were Mauser pistols and hand
grenades respectively. They ordered me to drive back to
Ts An Fang off Edinburgh Road, and this I did via Canton
Road, Honan Road, Ave Edward VII, Ave Foch and Great Western
Road. They alighted outside the entrance to Dah Sing Tsung,
Ts An Fang, and I observed them entering the alleyway. I
noticed that one of them wearing white short jacket was
wounded in the lower part of his body who was therefore
helped by two of his comrades. They did not pay the fare
and as I was frightened I drove the car back to the station.
I observed my car cushion being blood stained and I narrated
the whole story to the accountant Mr. Yang Ching Yuen who
accompanied me to drive to the Central Police Station.
It was about 10pm.

（批：Wlo 26/7）

Cross-signed.
pages.zh:
- 2 -
他们身上，我观察到分别持有毛瑟手枪和手榴弹。他们命令我开车返回爱丁堡路旁的泰安坊（Ts An Fang），我经由广东路、河南路、爱德华七世大道、福煦路和大西路行驶。他们在泰安坊大新宗入口处下车，我看着他们进入弄堂。我注意到其中一名身穿白色短夹克的男子下半身受伤，由两名同伙搀扶。他们未付车费，因我心存恐惧，便驾车返回车行。我发现车座垫上有血迹，遂向会计杨庆元（Yang Ching Yuen）先生讲述了全部经过，他陪同我驱车前往中央捕房。当时约为晚上10点。

（批注：Wlo 7月26日）

Zung Kuh Chi

Central Stn.        24/7/38

    Zung Kuh Chi, aged 26 years, S/Employed as a messenger
and residing at the National News Agency, 53 Foochow Rd.
    At about 8.15p.m. on July 22nd, I left my office and
proceeded to the China-American Daily News, 160 Av. Ed. VII
for the purpose of delivering a telegraph message. I entered
the back door which is situated in the Zang Kung Lee Alleyway
next to the mentioned newspaper office and proceeded to the
Registry Office on the 2nd floor. After having delivered the
document I went downstairs and on the way down the stairs I
encountered approximately 7 persons who were walking upstairs.
The first man was wearing white sun helmet, black clothes
(I could not see clearly whether the man was wearing foreign
or Chinese dress) while the 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th were unknown.
The 6th man was wearing black long gown, very low and small
build. The 7th man was also unknown. When they passed me I
observed that each of them was drawing a Mauser pistol from
the waist. Judging that they were police-officers I stopped
on the stairs and watched at them, but on seeing that the 6th
and 7th were in possession of hand-grenades I thought that they
were undesirables, so I took to my heels. I intended to get my
bicycle left outside the back door but I found that the door
was guarded by two men. The last man was wearing dark grey
flower designed silk long gown, his left sleeve was rolled over
while in his right hand was a Mauser pistol, who ordered me not
to walk further otherwise I would be shot. The description of
the 2nd man who was standing outside the back door was unknown
to me. I then stood beside the staircase as instructed.
pages.zh:
钟国治（音译）

中央巡捕房        1938年7月24日

    钟国治（音译），26岁，受雇为信差，居住于福州路53号国民通讯社。
    7月22日晚约8点15分，我离开办公室，前往爱多亚路160号《中美日报》送达一份电报。我进入了位于该报馆旁张公李弄堂（音译）的后门，并前往二楼的挂号处。递交文件后，我下楼，在楼梯途中遇到大约7名正上楼的人。第一个人戴着白色遮阳帽，身穿黑衣（我看不清此人是穿西式服装还是中式服装），而第二、三、四、五人身份不明。第六人身穿黑色长衫，身材非常矮小。第七人亦身份不明。当他们经过我身边时，我观察到他们每人都从腰间拔出一支毛瑟手枪。判断他们是警务人员，我便在楼梯上停下注视他们，但看到第六和第七人持有手榴弹后，我认为他们是不法之徒，于是拔腿就跑。我打算取回留在后门外的自行车，但发现门口有两人把守。最后那人穿着深灰色花纹丝绸长衫，左袖卷起，右手持一支毛瑟手枪，命令我不许再走，否则开枪射击。站在后门外的第二人的体貌特征我不清楚。随后我按指示站在楼梯旁。

pages.en:
Page 2

Meanwhile, I heard pistol shots proceeding from the 2nd floor.
About 5 or 6 minutes later, all the men came downstairs with
Mauser pistols in their hands and as I was so frightened I
dared not look at them. After they emerged from the house and
I found that there was no body to guard me, I prepared to leave
the place. Upon hearing the pistol shots in the Zang Kung Lee
alleyway I still stood inside in order to avoid being injured
by stray bullets. After the pistol shots and explosions were
over, (it was about 10 minutes later) I again went upstairs
and informed a clerk (name unknown) attached to the Registry
Office of the Chinese-American Daily News regarding the incident
which I had seen. I overheard some employees in the office
stating that the attack was carried out by traitors. Shortly
afterwards the police arrived at the scene. I remained in the
above mentioned newspaper office about 30 minutes.

On July 24th I was summoned by Police to attend the station
where I made a statement regarding the incident of what I had
seen or heard as above. I am not in a position to identify
the gangsters at present or in the future, because such an attack
was a great shock to me.

The above is my true statement.

Signed: Zung Kuh Chi.
pages.zh:
第2页

与此同时，我听到二楼传来枪声。大约5或6分钟后，所有人手持毛瑟手枪下楼，由于我非常恐惧，不敢看他们。待他们走出房屋，我发现无人看守我，便准备离开现场。听到张公李弄堂（音译）传来枪声后，我仍站在屋内，以避免被流弹所伤。枪声和爆炸声停止后（大约过了10分钟），我再次上楼，将我所见之事告知《中美日报》挂号处的一名职员（姓名不详）。我无意中听到办公室里的一些员工称此次袭击是由汉奸所为。不久后警察抵达现场。我在上述报馆停留了约30分钟。

7月24日，我应警方传唤到巡捕房，就上述我所见所闻的事件作了陈述。目前或将来我都无法指认这些暴徒，因为此次袭击对我造成了巨大的惊吓。

以上是我的真实陈述。

签名：钟国治（音译）。

At 10.30 a.m. on the 26/7/39 Messrs. Francis
reconnoitred by Judges E.R. Lurton and Mr. Gordon
Campbell United States Marshal for China proceeded to
Loh Ka Wei Station, French Police, in connection with
this case.

Superintendents Valentine and Berthier on being
interviewed stated that they had ascertained that at the
time the shooting commenced, Mr. Wilson (now deceased)
was inside the Frisco Cafe. On hearing the affray he
ran out but in doing so was held back by one named
Williams. However Mr. Wilson struggled free, and ran
in a Northerly direction across Av. Ed. VII where he
was shot.

issued and is in the possession of the French Police.

Judge Lurton and Mr. Campbell viewed the body at

deceased to the parlours of the International Funeral
Directors.

An inquest will be opened at 10.30am. on the
25/7/39 by Judge Lurton at the American Court. Supt.
Valintine is making arrangements for witnesses to attend.

CRIME DIARY NO. 1. (SHEET NO. 2)

Remarks
[Any recording of peculiar feature to be
communicated by investigating officer]

In consequence of two very loud explosions,
a police uniform was opened & taking
place in the vicinity of Avenue ____ Hall,
available men in the station were at once turned
out under ____ est and proceeded at full pelt
____ 22, A.D.

On proceeding to the intersection of
Avenue ____ and ____ it was
ascertained that a bombing and shooting of
considerable magnitude had taken place in the
vicinity of the "China Trade Building" 180
Avenue Edward VII.

The locality was found to be in a state
of great confusion and several wounded pedestrians
and police officers were found to be lying on
Klange Road and Avenue Edward VII.

Ambulances were called and all injured
persons conveyed to hospital as speedily as
possible.

The area was cordoned off and search
parties under Inspt. Williamson and D.S.I. Nair
searched all adjoining alleyways.

The Reserve Unit under Supt. Lowndes
attended and also assisted in the search.

Empty cartridge cases were picked up at
various points along Avenue Edward VII and
Klange Road indicating that a gun
battle had taken place and that shots
had fired indiscriminately by persons
retreating from the scene of the explosion.

**〔此处转录不清〕**

查明在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）180号
“中国贸易大厦”（China Trade Building）附近
发生了一起规模相当大的爆炸和枪击事件。

发现该地区处于极度混乱状态，
在江西路（Klange Road，即今江西中路）和爱多亚路上
发现数名受伤的行人和警察躺在地上。

呼叫了救护车，所有伤者被尽快送往医院。

该区域被封锁，由威廉姆森（Williamson）巡官和南伊尔（Nair）副巡官率领的搜查队
搜查了所有相邻的小巷。

由朗兹（Lowndes）警司率领的后备队
到场并协助搜查。

在爱多亚路和江西路沿线的各个地点
捡到了空弹壳，表明曾发生枪战，
且有人从爆炸现场撤退时
 indiscriminately（无差别地）开枪射击。

It is not known if any-one sustained injuries as

Several bullets penetrated the framework of two
railless tramcars (No.B.368 and B.357) travelling on
Kiangse Road at the time the shooting affray took
place.
Fortunately no reports have as yet been received of
any of the passengers travelling in the railless cars
having sustained injuries.
The driver of car No.B.357 was wounded in the left
leg. This man had a very narrow escape from death
as a bullet penetrated the glass frame just above his
head.
Thirteen wounded and dying Chinese were collected

一枚手榴弹在《字林西报》大楼（China Press Building）正门前被投掷并爆炸。
该建筑物似乎受损甚微，
目前尚不清楚是否有人因此次爆炸而伤亡。
另一枚柄式手榴弹（potato masher type）也被投掷到同一地区，但未爆炸。
还有一枚手榴弹在江西路42号正门外被投掷并爆炸，
该处距离《字林西报》大楼约
两三百码。
尚不清楚是否有人因此次爆炸受伤。
人行道路缘石受到轻微损坏。
在枪战发生时，
几颗子弹穿透了两辆行驶在江西路上的
无轨电车（编号B.368和B.357）的车架。
幸运的是，目前尚未收到
乘坐这些无轨电车的任何乘客受伤的报告。

and despatched to various hospitals.

Two of the victims sustained fatal injuries and
were pronounced dead on or shortly after arrival at
hospital.

Members of the French Police took part in the
affray and it is reported that over 50 shots were fired
at the retreating terrorists by the French Police.
They sustained no casualties.

Officials of the French Police reported that a
Mr. A.F. "TUG" WILSON, American citizen, owner of the
New Ritz Restaurant, 31 Avenue Edward VII, French
Concession had been wounded in the chest and conveyed
by them to the St. Marie's Hospital. At 10 p.m. a
telephone message was received from the French Police
reporting that Mr. Wilson had succumbed to his injuries.

Mr. Gordon Campbell, U.S. Court Marshal, was
informed of the wounding of Mr. Wilson by D.S. Jones
who telephoned him from the Frisco Cafe.

Mr. Campbell stated that he would attend the
St. Marie's Hospital immediately.

Just how Mr. Wilson got into the line of fire and
was wounded is not definitely known. It is reported
that he rushed across the road to the scene of the
shooting and in doing so was struck in the chest.
pages.zh:

并被送往各家医院。

其中两名受害者受致命伤，
在抵达医院时或抵达后不久被宣布死亡。

法国警察成员参与了此次斗殴，
据报道，法国警察向撤退的恐怖分子开了50多枪。
他们无人伤亡。

法国警察官员报告称，
美国公民、法租界爱多亚路31号新丽都餐厅（New Ritz Restaurant）老板
A.F.“塔格”·威尔逊（A.F. "TUG" WILSON）先生胸部中弹，
被他们送往圣玛丽医院（St. Marie's Hospital）。
晚上10点，接到法国警察的电话消息，
报告威尔逊先生因伤不治身亡。

美国法院法警戈登·坎贝尔（Gordon Campbell）先生
由琼斯（Jones）副巡官从弗里斯科咖啡馆（Frisco Cafe）打电话通知了威尔逊先生受伤的消息。

坎贝尔先生表示他将立即前往
圣玛丽医院。

威尔逊先生是如何卷入火线并受伤的，
目前尚不完全清楚。据报道，他冲过马路前往枪击现场，
在此过程中胸部中弹。

pages.en:
-4-

This will be subject to further investigation in
due course. It is believed that no difficulty will
be experienced in locating eye-witnesses who will
testify as to Mr. Wilson's movements at the time.
Included in the 13 casualties are the
undermentioned C.P.Cs. who are now detained in the
Police Hospital.
1. C.P.C.1580(C) Bullet wound of right leg
with fracture.
2. C.P.C.1472(C) Bullet wound of right leg.
3. C.P.C.1896(C) Bullet wound of right knee.
The target of the terrorists attack is believed
to have been the printing establishment of the
British-owned and registered "China Evening News"
located at No.130 Chang Keng Lee (香耕里) Avenue
Edward VII with offices at 160 Avenue Edward VII.
This paper is published by the Independent Publishing
Company, under the Managing-Directorship of Mr.
B.H.FLETT. The paper is reported to be edited by
Mr.S.E.YOUNG.
In addition to the China Evening News there
is also housed in the same building the "China-
American Daily News" and the "China Press".
The China-American Daily News which is
published by the Roosevelt Publishing Company

此事将在适当时候作进一步调查。据信，
寻找能证词说明威尔逊先生当时行踪的目击者不会有什么困难。
在13名伤亡者中，包括以下几名华捕（C.P.Cs.），
他们现被羁押在警察医院。
1. 华捕1580号(C) 右腿枪伤伴骨折。
2. 华捕1472号(C) 右腿枪伤。

据信，恐怖分子袭击的目标是
位于爱多亚路香耕里130号、办公地点在爱多亚路160号的
英资注册报纸《上海晚报》（China Evening News）的印刷所。
该报由独立出版公司（Independent Publishing Company）出版，
董事总经理为B.H.弗莱特（B.H.FLETT）先生。
据报道，该报由S.E.杨（S.E.YOUNG）先生编辑。
除了《上海晚报》外，
同一栋楼内还设有《中美日报》（China-American Daily News）和《字林西报》（China Press）。
《中美日报》由罗斯福出版公司（Roosevelt Publishing Company）出版

pages.en:
-5-

occupy the upper part of the building together with
the China Press.

investigation do show that an attempt was made
by the terrorists to gain access into the three
printing rooms for no other purpose than shooting
up the place.

It would appear that an incident similar to that
carried out by terrorists against the British-owned
"Morning Leader" some weeks ago.had been planned.
The building is located in a very badly lighted alleyway
with several sub alleyways at the rear.

It has not been possible to obtain full details
from the police on duty at the building but the
following is believed a fairly accurate record of what
occurred.

It is reported that over twenty males entered the
alleyway and on being challenged by C.P.C.1895(plain
clothes) they opened fire. This C.P.C. immediately
fled from the alleyway whilst the terrorists deployed
and entered the front and rear doors of the building.

C.P.C.1472 who was on duty at the main entrance
to the building was surrounded by at least five of
the terrorists all of whom were armed with military
type Mauser pistols.
pages.zh:
-5-

与《字林西报》一起占据该建筑的上层部分。

调查显示，恐怖分子曾试图进入这三个印刷车间，
其目的纯粹是为了扫射该场所。

这似乎是一起类似于几周前恐怖分子对英资《导报》（Morning Leader）
实施的袭击事件那样的预谋行动。
该建筑位于一条照明极差的小巷内，
后面有几条分支小巷。

虽然无法从在该建筑执勤的警察那里获得全部细节，
但以下被认为是相当准确的事发记录。

据报道，超过二十名男子进入小巷，
当受到华捕1895号（便衣）的盘查时，他们开火射击。
这名华捕立即从小巷逃离，
而恐怖分子则散开并进入了该建筑的前后门。

在大楼主入口执勤的华捕1472号
被至少五名恐怖分子包围，
这些人全都装备有军用型毛瑟手枪。

pages.en:
-6-

Several of the terrorists proceeded upstairs
evidently heading for the rooms occupied by the
American-Daily News and the China Press. On finding
the doors giving access to this part of the building
were locked the terrorists retreated and entered the
office of the Tsu Hsing Printing Company ( 印刷 )
where they fired several shots.

In the meantime shooting was going on inside
the rooms occupied by the China Evening News. Many
shots were fired inside this part of the building
and two persons were wounded rather seriously as the
result. It is reported by the employees that over
ten men all of whom were armed with Mausers entered
the room. One of the employees sustained fatal
injuries and died shortly after admission to hospital.

There is also evidence that some of the gunmen
entered the Tung Wai Trust Company ( 通匯 ), 150
Avenue Edward VII where several shots were fired. An
elderly tea-boy employed by the Trust Company was
shot in the chest and died instantaneously. Many empty
cartridge cases were found in the rear corridor of
these premises.

The attack on the two places appears to have been
carried out simultaneously and it is believed that the
pages.zh:
-6-

几名恐怖分子上楼，
显然是前往《中美日报》和《字林西报》所在的房间。
当发现通往该建筑这一部分的门被锁住时，
恐怖分子撤退并进入了聚兴印刷公司（Tsu Hsing Printing Company）的办公室，
在那里开了几枪。

与此同时，《上海晚报》所在的房间内也在进行射击。
该建筑这部分区域内发射了许多子弹，
导致两人受重伤。
据员工报告，超过十名手持毛瑟枪的男子进入了房间。
一名员工受致命伤，
入院后不久死亡。

还有证据表明，一些枪手进入了
位于爱多亚路150号的通汇信托公司（Tung Wai Trust Company），
并在那里开了几枪。
信托公司的一名老年茶房被击中胸部，当场死亡。
在这些场所的后走廊里发现了大量空弹壳。

对这两个地方的袭击似乎是同时进行的，据信

pages.en:
-7-

Tung Wei Trust Company's property was mistaken for a
newspaper office.

C.P.C.1472 was disarmed and fired at by one of
the gunmen with the result that he was wounded in the
right leg. His pistol was not discarded but carried
off by his assailants.

The gunmen on retreating from the alleyway were
again challenged by C.P.C.2919 who fired several shots.
He was joined by C.P.C.570 who also fired several
shots.

Many shots were fired in the alleyway and along
Avenue Edward VII by the terrorists.

They also appear to have had a plentiful supply
of hand-grenades which they freely flourished whilst
fleeing from the scene. Several of the gunmen also
carried torches.

The gunmen deployed in various directions, but
it is believed that many of them headed for Kiangse
Road.

Shots were fired by the gunmen all along the
route and as previously stated two hand-grenades
were thrown in order to scare away the police.

Members of the French Police took a hand in the
affray and fired many shots at the fleeing men.
pages.zh:

通汇信托公司的产业被误认为是报社办公室。

华捕1472号被解除武装，
并被一名枪手射击，导致右腿受伤。
他的手枪未被丢弃，而是被袭击者带走。

枪手从小巷撤退时，
再次受到华捕2919号的盘查，后者开了几枪。
华捕570号也加入其中，同样开了几枪。

恐怖分子在小巷内以及沿着爱多亚路
发射了许多子弹。

他们似乎还拥有充足的手榴弹供应，
在逃离现场时随意挥舞。几名枪手还携带了手电筒。

枪手向各个方向散开，
但据信许多人朝江西路方向逃去。

枪手沿途一路开枪，如前所述，
为了吓退警察，他们投掷了两枚手榴弹。

法国警察成员参与了此次斗殴，
并向逃跑的人员发射了许多子弹。

after the shooting started. (correct)
One Japanese named Masao Fujimoto was arrested at the
scene shortly after the arrival of the Police. He
was questioned and handed over to the Japanese Consular
Police. There is at present no evidence to indicate
that he is involved in the affray.
Altogether 90 empty cartridge cases of various
calibre, ten rounds of .38 Mauser ammunition, three
bullets, three grenade caps and two ammunition clips
have been picked up at the scene.
The Reserve Unit conducted a further search of the
vicinity at daybreak.
It is believed that the Lousa search party operating
on Hankow Road near Chekiang Road under P.S. 106
Zborovsky encountered some of the men concerned in
this outrage. A report made by D.S. Wright covers
the Lousa incident which will now be investigated
from this station.
The above is only a rough outline of what
occurred and fuller details will be covered in
subsequent diaries. Statements have been taken and
will be forwarded when translated.

Young so (周安昌)，执照号 1014）从东面驶来。

当车辆经过巡逻队时，后座的一名乘客向印捕 156号 Zborovsky 开了一枪，并在车辆加速逃离时，

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of F.P.C. 156 V. Zborovsky.
native of ........................................ taken by me.
at Louza Stn. on the 22-7-39. and interpreted by ........................................

Sir,

I beg to report the following:-

At 7 p.m. 22-7-39 I was detailed for walking S'party
together with C.P.Cs. 1144, 169 and 1079, operating south
of Nanking Road between 7 p.m. and 9 p.m.

At 8.30 p.m. whilst on Hankow Road near Chekiang Road
I observed a hire M/car approaching at a high speed from E.
to W on Hankow Road. At this time I was standing in the
middle of the road and put up my hand as a signal for the
M/car to stop. The M/car immediately slowed down but as I
approached, it suddenly picked up speed and at the same time
a shot was fired at me by a passenger in the rear seat.

The car passed me and as it was speeding away, several
more shots were fired from the rear of the car. I immediately
opened fire whereupon the car which by this time had crossed
Chekiang Road pulled into the kerb on the south side of the
road and stopped.

Immediately it stopped the occupants of the car opened
the doors and jumped out from both sides. I noticed one of
the men who had a pistol in his hand was firing in my direc-
tion. At this time also I noticed two men lying on the north
side of Hankow Road near the kerb. Suddenly they both jumped
up and ran into an alleyway. I fired one shot at them and
then paused to reload, as by this time my magazine was empty.
Accompanied by C.P.C. 1869 I ran to the entrance of the alley-
way and just as we were entering, a shot was fired by some one
in the alleyway. As we could not see the person who had fired

先生，

谨报告如下：-

1939年7月22日晚上7点，我被指派与华捕 1144、169 和 1079号组成步行巡逻队，
在晚上7点至9点期间在南京路以南区域执勤。

晚上8点30分，当我在浙江路附近的汉口路上时，观察到一辆出租机动车在汉口路上
从东向西高速驶来。当时我站在路中间，举手示意该机动车停车。机动车立即减速，但当我
走近时，它突然加速，同时后座的一名乘客向我开了一枪。

车辆从我身边驶过，并在加速逃离时，从车后部又射出数枪。我立即
还击，此时车辆已穿过浙江路，驶向道路南侧的路缘并停下。

车辆一停下，车内人员便打开车门从两侧跳下。我注意到其中一名手持手枪的男子正朝我的方向
射击。此时我还注意到两名男子躺在汉口路北侧靠近路缘的地方。突然他们两人都跳起来
跑进一条弄堂。我向他们开了一枪，然后暂停装弹，因为此时我的弹匣已空。
在华捕 1869号的陪同下，我跑到弄堂入口，正当我们进入时，弄堂内有人开了一枪。由于我们看不见开枪的人
